paper.title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
paper.abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) promise to provide embodied AI with scalable predictive simulators for planning, policy evaluation, and data generation. Realizing this promise requires precise action-conditioned transitions rather than merely plausible outputs. Yet their applicability remains difficult to establish because prevailing evaluations emphasize visual quality, task outcomes, or coarse rollout-level responsiveness without directly testing simulator fidelity. To address this gap

summary.core_problem: 现有 embodied world model 评测过度依赖视觉质量或任务成功率，无法直接判断 action-conditioned world model 是否真的具备可用的模拟器忠实度。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测协议与诊断基准，而不是新模型。对做统一 world model、视频预测、行动条件生成的研究员有参考价值，因为它把“看起来像”与“可作为规划模拟器”明确分开。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Observable Simulator Contract，要求一个物理模拟器至少满足两点：输入动作必须诱发对应的 agent 运动，环境响应必须以该已实现运动为条件。基于这个契约构建 WorldSimProbe，包含五组受控测试，覆盖局部控制敏感性、全局轨迹一致性等，用来诊断 ACWM 的 simulator faithfulness，而非只看 rollout 观感。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和数值，但可以确认评测对象是 embodied manipulation 中的 action-conditioned world models。实验重点不是 leaderboard，而是揭示现有模型即便视觉上合理、任务上可用，也可能在动作-状态因果一致性上失败。对比维度比常见视频生成评测更贴近 planning/data generation 的真实需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of embodied world models focus too much on visual quality or task success, and fail to directly test whether action-conditioned world models are faithful enough to function as simulators.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a new model. It is relevant to researchers working on unified world models, action-conditioned generation, or planning-oriented predictive models because it separates 'looks plausible' from 'works as a simulator.'
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Observable Simulator Contract: a physical simulator should at minimum ensure that supplied actions induce corresponding agent motion, and that environment responses are grounded in that realized motion. It then builds WorldSimProbe, a controlled diagnostic benchmark with five suites covering local control sensitivity, global trajectory consistency, and related aspects of simulator faithfulness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list exact models or numbers, but the targets are action-conditioned world models for embodied manipulation. The key point is diagnostic: models that look visually plausible or support task-level success may still fail on action-state causal consistency, which standard rollout metrics often miss.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，但把 world model 评测口径掰正了：若你关心 action-conditioned generation，先看它怎么定义 simulator contract，再决定该信哪些结果。
recommendation.en: It does not improve models, but it fixes the evaluation lens: if you care about action-conditioned generation, read how it defines simulator faithfulness before trusting flashy rollout results.

paper.title: PhysX-CoT: Structured Physical Reasoning from a Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
paper.abstract: Simulation-ready 3D assets are central to robotics and embodied AI. Generating them from a single image is usually framed as a vision-language model that emits a serialized asset for a decoder to turn into geometry and physical fields, leaving the image-to-3D reasoning implicit. We argue the limiting factor is this output-centric view: part placement and local shape are entangled in one global-coordinate token stream, and the intermediate physical states are never exposed for supervision, condit

summary.core_problem: 从单张图像生成仿真就绪3D资产时，现有方法将图像到3D的推理隐式化，零件放置与局部形状纠缠在全局坐标token流中
summary.importance: 方法创新，将单图像3D资产生成重新建模为显式结构化物理推理过程，而非端到端序列化输出
summary.technical_approach: PhysX-CoT把生成分解为零件级状态的有序可解析轨迹（分解、2D/3D grounding、关系、粗几何、表面线索），各阶段分别监督并作为几何条件和奖励目标；几何因子化为3D box（位置）+ local code（形状）；用CoT对齐的GRPO优化解析有效性
summary.experiments: 单图像到仿真就绪3D资产生成任务，验证结构化推理轨迹相比隐式序列化输出的优势
summary.authors_note: 作者含Chen Qian等，跨机构合作

summary_en.core_problem: Existing single-image-to-3D-asset methods treat image-to-3D reasoning implicitly, entangling part placement and local shape in one global-coordinate token stream
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation reframing single-image 3D asset generation as an explicit structured physical reasoning process rather than end-to-end serialized output
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysX-CoT decomposes generation into an ordered, machine-parseable trajectory of part-level states (decomposition, 2D/3D grounding, relations, coarse geometry, surface cues), each separately supervised and used as geometry conditioning and reward targets; geometry factorized into 3D boxes (placement) + local codes (shape); CoT-aligned GRPO optimizes parse validity
summary_en.experiments: Single-image to simulation-ready 3D asset generation, validating structured reasoning trajectory over implicit serialized output
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Chen Qian; cross-institutional collaboration

recommendation.zh: 核心是3D生成，结构化推理+GRPO的思路对post-training有微弱参考，但与LLM预训练距离远，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Core is 3D generation; the structured-reasoning-plus-GRPO angle has marginal post-training relevance but is far from LLM pretraining. Abstract suffices.

paper.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
paper.abstract: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not as

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多智能体世界模型训练与推理时智能体数量固定、无法扩展到任意群体规模的问题
summary.importance: 多智能体世界建模的架构范式创新，通过解耦世界状态演化与渲染实现推理时群体规模可扩展，对通用具身智能体预训练框架有参考价值
summary.technical_approach: 提出Khora框架，将共享世界状态演化与智能体特定渲染解耦，引入群体无关渲染接口，通过查询共享状态生成任意数量智能体的观测，无需重训练
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据与量化对比结果，仅说明支持推理时智能体数量扩展与跨视角一致性

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the fixed agent count limitation of existing multi-agent world models, which prevents scaling to arbitrary population sizes at inference without retraining
summary_en.importance: An architectural paradigm innovation for multi-agent world modeling that decouples state evolution from rendering to enable inference-time population scaling, with relevance to general embodied agent pretraining frameworks
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Khora, which decouples shared world-state evolution from agent-specific rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering interface that queries the shared state to generate observations for any number of agents without retraining
summary_en.experiments: Concrete model scale, training data, and quantitative comparison results are not disclosed in the abstract; only inference-time agent scalability and cross-view consistency are claimed

recommendation.zh: 世界模型解耦状态与渲染的思路对具身智能体预训练框架有弱参考，但实验披露不足，仅看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The decoupled state-rendering design for world models offers weak reference for embodied agent pretraining, but experimental disclosure is insufficient; only skim the method section.

paper.title: GST-Bench: Can VLMs Develop Global Spatial Awareness from Video?
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence is fundamental to embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks focus on local spatial perception from single or few viewpoints, overlooking global spatial awareness over continuous, long-horizon visual streams. To address this limitation, we introduce the Global-Spatial-Temporal Benchmark (GST-Bench), a VQA benchmark for global spatial intelligence in video understanding, comprising human-verified questions derived from 6,790 minutes of synthetically generated video. It requires

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的视频问答，而是 VLM 在连续第一视角视频中能否形成“全局空间表征”。更具体地说，模型是否能把沿轨迹看到的局部观察整合成一致的场景地图，并在一个从未出现在视频轨迹上的新视角下，回答“我在哪里、目标在哪里、场景整体长什么样”这三类问题。作者认为现有空间 benchmark 大多停留在单帧或少量视角，很多题目其实可以靠局部线索或单图感知完成，无法真正测到跨时间、跨视角、带全局坐标约束的空间推理能力。GST-Bench 的核心设计就是把这些捷径尽量堵住：目标物体在 query 视角中不可见，query 视角不在原视频轨迹上，答案采用距离和角度等精确数值而不是粗粒度左右前后判断，并显式引入 top-down 图像来测试局部观察到全局地图的映射能力。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“视频理解”里常被混在一起的局部感知、短程时序建模、全局空间整合拆开了，给出了一个更接近 embodied pretraining 需求的评测面。第二，它揭示了当前强 VLM 的失败模式并不统一：闭源大模型在把任务退化成局部可见后能大幅提升，说明主要短板在跨帧空间整合；不少开源模型即便在局部版本上也提不起来，说明感知和推理两端都弱。这种诊断对后续数据设计、架构设计、视频 tokenization 和训练目标都很有用。第三，作者不只做 benchmark，还给出同管线生成的 GST-Train，并展示定向训练能把 Qwen3-VL-8B 从 25.89 拉到 53.52，超过零样本闭源模型。这说明全局空间能力并非纯靠更大模型自然涌现，训练数据分布和任务构造本身就是关键变量。对做原生多模态预训练的人，这比单纯 leaderboard 更有信息量。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三个关键点。其一是数据生成管线。作者基于 OmniGibson 和 BEHAVIOR-1K 的 50 个室内场景，自动采样多样化相机轨迹，并额外采样不在轨迹上的 query viewpoint。系统记录对象和视角的 3D 坐标，再投影到全局 top-down 图中，自动构造问答对。这里最重要的过滤规则是：所有 object localization 相关样本都要求目标在 query 视角不可见，从源头上避免单帧解题。其二是任务 taxonomy。围绕 embodied agent 的三个基本问题——self localization、object localization、scene structure understanding——组织成 12 个子任务。论文强调这些任务不是简单换问法，而是分别考察局部到全局映射、跨视角目标定位、全局布局恢复等不同能力。其三是诊断性对照设计。作者构造了 local variants，把目标改成在 query 视角可见，使任务更接近单图感知，从而把“看不见所以不会答”和“看得见但不会整合”区分开。这个设计很关键，因为它让 benchmark 不只是排名工具，也能定位瓶颈。

从建模角度看，这篇工作本身不是提出新 VLM 架构，而是提出一种更严格的能力定义和数据构造方式。它隐含的研究判断是：如果训练目标没有迫使模型维护显式或隐式的全局空间状态，单靠通用图文视频语料，模型很容易学到局部相关性而不是可迁移的空间表征。top-down 图像的引入也很有意思，它相当于给“世界模型是否形成”提供了一个可操作的外部探针，比只问自然语言问题更接近结构化评估。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最有信息量的是三组结果。第一组是主 benchmark 评测。作者评测了 22 个 VLM，覆盖开源、闭源以及偏 embodied 的模型。最强零样本模型 Gemini-3-Pro 只有 42.68，而人类是 79.08，差距很大。开源模型整体更低，最强的 InternVL3.5-38B 也只在 30 分左右，很多模型接近随机水平。这个结果说明当前视频 VLM 的“会看视频”并不等于“能建立全局空间地图”。第二组是 local variant 对照。闭源模型在局部版本上最高能提升 39 分，说明其单图感知和局部空间判断并不差，主要卡在跨帧整合和 novel viewpoint 推断；开源模型提升不稳定，说明问题不只是 memory 或 temporal aggregation，也包括基础视觉感知和空间 grounding。第三组是 GST-Train 微调。作者用同一生成管线构建训练集，来源包括 BEHAVIOR-1K、ArtVIP、HyperSim 和内部模拟场景。Qwen3-VL-8B 在 GST-Train 上微调后，GST-Bench 分数从 25.89 提升到 53.52，提升 27.63 分，并超过所有零样本闭源模型。这个幅度说明 benchmark 与训练数据分布高度对齐，同时也说明全局空间推理是可学的，不是单纯靠更大参数规模才能得到。

从消融和分析角度，最值得注意的是作者对“局部可见/不可见”的严格控制，以及 query viewpoint 脱离原轨迹这一设置。它显著提高了任务难度，也更接近机器人探索后从新位置做判断的场景。另一个重要细节是答案采用精确数值指标，这避免了很多 benchmark 常见的模糊评分问题，使得误差分析更细。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里对现有空间 benchmark 缺陷的三点批评，再看任务定义和数据构造部分，重点确认作者是如何保证题目不能被单帧或局部启发式解掉的。真正的核心不在模型列表，而在 sample filtering、novel viewpoint 采样、top-down 映射和 12 个子任务的划分逻辑。

精读时优先看三类图表：一是 benchmark taxonomy 和数据生成流程图，理解每类题到底测什么；二是主结果表，尤其是 human、闭源、开源、embodied 模型之间的差距；三是 local variant 与 GST-Train 微调结果，这两部分最能说明失败模式和可改进方向。若从预训练角度阅读，值得深挖的问题有三个：第一，现有视频预训练目标为什么没有逼出稳定的全局空间状态；第二，top-down supervision 是否可以转化为预训练中的辅助目标；第三，模拟数据带来的收益能否迁移到真实世界视频。阅读时间大约 45–60 分钟，若要做相关研究，数据构造细节和附录中的过滤规则需要仔细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of current VLMs: they may parse local visual content from videos, yet still fail to build a globally consistent spatial representation over time. The benchmark asks whether a model can integrate egocentric observations along a trajectory, infer spatial relations from a novel viewpoint that never appears in the input video, and align local observations with an explicit top-down scene representation. This is different from standard video QA. The authors deliberately remove shortcuts: the queried target is invisible from the query view, the query camera is sampled off-trajectory, and answers are evaluated with precise numerical quantities such as distance and angle rather than coarse left/right judgments.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is diagnostic rather than merely competitive. First, it separates local perception from global spatial integration, which many existing video benchmarks do not. That matters for embodied pretraining, world modeling, and native multimodal training. Second, it shows that failure modes differ by model family: strong proprietary models improve sharply when the task is reduced to local perception, suggesting that their main weakness is cross-frame spatial integration; many open models do not improve reliably even then, indicating deficits in both perception and reasoning. Third, the paper goes beyond evaluation by introducing GST-Train and showing that targeted training data can substantially close the gap. Qwen3-VL-8B improves from 25.89 to 53.52 after fine-tuning, surpassing all zero-shot proprietary models in their setup. That is a useful signal for pretraining researchers: global spatial competence is not something to assume will emerge automatically from scale alone; data construction and task pressure matter.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is centered on benchmark and data design rather than a new VLM architecture. The pipeline is built on OmniGibson with BEHAVIOR-1K scenes. For each of 50 indoor environments, the system generates diverse egocentric camera trajectories and additional query viewpoints outside the trajectory. It records 3D coordinates of objects and viewpoints, projects them onto top-down maps, and automatically creates QA pairs. A key filtering rule removes any sample where the target object is visible from the query viewpoint, ensuring that object-localization questions cannot be solved from a single frame.

The task taxonomy is organized around three embodied questions: Where am I? Where is the target? What does the scene look like? These are instantiated as 12 subtasks covering self-localization, object localization, and scene-structure understanding. The top-down image is not cosmetic; it acts as an explicit probe of whether the model can map long-horizon egocentric evidence into a global scene representation.

A particularly strong part of the design is the controlled local variant. By making the target visible from the query viewpoint, the authors convert the task into one that can be handled largely by local perception. This creates a clean diagnostic split between failures caused by weak single-image understanding and failures caused by missing cross-view spatial integration. That makes GST-Bench more than a leaderboard asset; it becomes a tool for identifying what kind of spatial competence is absent.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluation covers 22 VLMs, including open-source, proprietary, and embodied-oriented models. The strongest zero-shot model, Gemini-3-Pro, reaches 42.68, far below the human score of 79.08. Open models are substantially weaker; the best reported open model, InternVL3.5-38B, stays around the low-30 range, and many models are close to random guessing. This gap is large enough that it is hard to dismiss as benchmark noise.

The local-variant analysis is one of the most informative results. Proprietary models can gain up to 39 points when the task is reduced to local perception, which strongly suggests that they already have decent local visual understanding but fail to maintain and use a global spatial state across frames. Open models, in contrast, do not improve consistently even in the local setting, pointing to a compound bottleneck involving both perception and reasoning.

The training-data experiment is equally important. Using the same generation pipeline, the authors build GST-Train from BEHAVIOR-1K, ArtVIP, HyperSim, and internal simulation scenes. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B on GST-Train raises its GST-Bench score from 25.89 to 53.52, a gain of 27.63 points, and pushes it above all proprietary models under zero-shot evaluation. That result suggests the benchmark is learnable with targeted supervision and that synthetic spatial data can materially improve global spatial reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the benchmark motivation and the three limitations the authors identify in prior spatial benchmarks. Then read the dataset construction section carefully, especially the filtering rules that prevent single-frame shortcuts. The benchmark is only convincing if those controls are sound.

The most important figures and tables are: the task taxonomy, the data-generation pipeline, the main model comparison table, the local-vs-global diagnostic results, and the GST-Train fine-tuning results. For a pretraining-oriented reader, three questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why current video pretraining objectives fail to induce stable global spatial representations; whether top-down alignment could be turned into an auxiliary pretraining objective; and how much of the gain from simulation-based data might transfer to real-world video. A careful first pass should take about an hour, and the appendix is worth reading if you care about benchmark validity.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和局部/全局拆分实验；它能提醒 VLM 预训练别把单帧空间题当作 embodied 能力代理。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and the local-vs-global split; it is a useful warning against treating single-frame spatial QA as a proxy for embodied spatial competence.

paper.title: SiMDex: Mining Similar Egocentric Videos for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
paper.abstract: Recent years have witnessed an explosive trend of scaling ego-centric human videos for robot manipulation, yet it remains unclear which data actually benefits dexterous manipulation. We present SiMDex, a similarity-based data mining framework that casts human data selection for VLA post-training in dexterous manipulation as a recommendation problem. For each robot demonstration, SiMDex employs a three-layer recall-ranking-re-ranking pipeline to extract task-relevant subsets from a pool of ~32M e

summary.core_problem: 在大规模人类第一视角视频池中，如何为机器人示范/具身 VLA 后训练挑出“真正有用”的少量数据，而不是盲目混合。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据筛选/课程：把数据选择显式建模为检索-排序问题，并用强对照（同等数据量随机采样）展示“少而精”优于“多而杂”；对通用 LLM 预训练是类比启发（data curation / retrieval-based mixture），但任务仍偏具身操作。
summary.technical_approach: SiMDex：三层 recall–ranking–re-ranking 管线，从约 3200 万 egocentric 人类视频中为每条机器人 demonstration 挖掘相似样本；在 morphology-agnostic action space 上做匹配，声称无需改 VLA 架构或训练方式，核心是数据选择策略。
summary.experiments: 从 32M 池中仅选 1.49M（<5%）样本用于训练/后训练，相比等量随机采样把总体成功率从 47.7% 提升到 61.1%；摘要未给出 VLA 规模、具体基线名称与任务集合细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mine a small but truly useful subset of large-scale egocentric human videos for robot demonstration / embodied VLA post-training, instead of indiscriminate mixing.
summary_en.importance: A data selection/curriculum contribution: frames data choice as retrieval-and-ranking and shows “less but curated” beats “more but random” under a strong equal-budget control; mainly embodied, but conceptually relevant to pretraining data curation and mixture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: SiMDex uses a three-stage recall–ranking–re-ranking pipeline to retrieve task-relevant human egocentric clips from a ~32M pool for each robot demonstration, operating in a morphology-agnostic action space without changing the VLA architecture/training recipe.
summary_en.experiments: Uses only 1.49M mined samples (<5% of 32M) and improves overall success rate from 47.7% to 61.1 versus an equal-size random-sampling baseline; model size/baseline details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把“数据配比”落到可执行的检索/重排管线，并给了强对照提升；但偏具身后训练，预训练侧只取其 data mining 思路。
recommendation.en: Good, actionable retrieval/rerank data-mining pipeline with a clean equal-budget control; still embodied post-training—borrow the curation idea, not the task specifics.

paper.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots

summary.core_problem: 发布 Gemini Robotics 2，主打面向机器人的 'whole body intelligence'，即把视觉、语言与肢体控制统一到一个模型中。
summary.importance: 顶级实验室具身智能方向的模型发布，但当前仅有公告，无技术报告。
summary.technical_approach: 未披露具体架构、训练数据或训练目标；从描述看是多模态 VLM 与机器人控制的联合建模。
summary.experiments: 无公开实验数据。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 官方公告，摘要缺失，信息有限。

summary_en.core_problem: Announces Gemini Robotics 2, emphasizing 'whole body intelligence' that unifies vision, language, and body control in one model.
summary_en.importance: A top-lab embodied-AI model release, but currently only an announcement with no technical report.
summary_en.technical_approach: No architecture, training data, or objective is disclosed; described as joint modeling of multimodal VLM capabilities with robot control.
summary_en.experiments: No public experimental results.
summary_en.authors_note: Official Google DeepMind announcement; abstract unavailable, so details are limited.

recommendation.zh: 只有公告没有论文，无法判断技术含量；标记关注，等技术报告再评估是否值得读。
recommendation.en: Announcement-only with no paper, so technical merit is unassessable; bookmark and revisit when the report drops.

paper.title: N_0-VTLA: Scaling Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Model with Latent Tactile Tokens
paper.abstract: We present N_0-VTLA, a vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) foundation model capable of (1) fine-grained contact-rich manipulation with tactile perception and tactile-feedback control, and (2) offline policy improvement from stored deployment data. Building on current vision-based backbones, we propose a training recipe for tactile integration consisting of visuo-tactile pre-training, staged tactile-pathway integration, and advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement. During pre-training,

summary.core_problem: 研究如何把触觉信号作为可训练模态接入 vision-language-action 模型，使机器人在接触密集的精细操作中利用触觉反馈。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态具身预训练和触觉 tokenization。它不是 LLM 基座预训练的核心论文，但“把新传感模态离散化或潜变量化后接入统一模型”的问题与多模态预训练有相通性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 N_0-VTLA，一个 vision-tactile-language-action foundation model。方法包括大规模 visuo-tactile pre-training、分阶段 tactile pathway integration，以及 advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement。触觉部分使用 latent tactile tokens，并通过预测式触觉通路把预训练中学到的接触模式迁移到下游精细动作控制。离线策略改进方法称为 ALTER。
summary.experiments: 摘要称模型在 NeoData 大规模视觉-触觉机器人数据上进行预训练，并面向 contact-rich manipulation 与存储部署数据上的 offline policy improvement。提供的摘要未给出参数量、NeoData 规模、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度，因此实验可信度需要看正文的 ablation 和数据覆盖。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 NeoteAI Team 和 Fudan TEAI Team。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to integrate tactile signals into vision-language-action models so that robots can use tactile feedback for fine-grained, contact-rich manipulation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in embodied multimodal pretraining and tactile tokenization. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to the broader question of how new sensory modalities can be represented and trained inside unified foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: N_0-VTLA is a vision-tactile-language-action foundation model using latent tactile tokens. The training recipe combines large-scale visuo-tactile pretraining, staged integration of a tactile pathway, and advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement. A predictive tactile pathway is used to distill contact patterns learned at scale into fine motion adjustments, and the offline improvement component is named ALTER.
summary_en.experiments: The model is pretrained on NeoData, described as a large-scale visuo-tactile robot dataset, and is evaluated for contact-rich manipulation and offline policy improvement from stored deployment data. The provided abstract does not report parameter counts, dataset size, baselines, or numerical gains, so the main evidence depends on the full ablations.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is by the NeoteAI Team and the Fudan TEAI Team.

recommendation.zh: 把 tactile 做 latent token 接到 VLA 值得登记；若正文没有干净 scaling 和 ablation，对 pretrain 只是模态 tokenization 备查。
recommendation.en: Worth logging for its latent tactile-token interface to VLA models; without clean scaling and ablations, it is mainly a modality-tokenization reference for pretraining work.

paper.title: ContactFlow: A video action conditioning that transfers across embodiments
paper.abstract: World models offer a promising route toward robot planning by enabling agents to imagine and verify the consequences of actions before execution. However, current video-based world models often struggle to capture the physical constraints that govern manipulation, particularly contact. Further, their action conditioning is often constrained to specific embodiments such as parallel grippers. We propose \emph{Contact Flow}, an embodiment-agnostic action representation that encodes manipulation thr

summary.core_problem: 让视频 world model 能用跨 embodiment 的动作条件生成物体交互结果，避免动作表示被某一种机器人夹爪或关节空间绑定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是动作表示与视频生成式 world model。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对具身基础模型如何设计 action token / action condition 有参考意义，尤其是从人类演示和机器人执行之间共享条件信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Contact Flow：用 actor 与目标物体之间 3D 接触点的轨迹来编码操作动作，刻意丢弃 actor 外观和具体运动学结构。作者据此把人类交互视频和机器人交互视频放在同一个条件空间中，训练条件视频生成模型预测物理上合理的操作后果，并将该模型接入 propose-and-verify 风格的规划流程。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明使用人类和机器人物体交互视频训练大规模视频生成模型，并用于预测 manipulation outcomes；但没有给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to condition video world models on actions in a way that transfers across embodiments, rather than tying the action space to a specific robot gripper or joint configuration.
summary_en.importance: This is an action-representation and generative world-model contribution. It is not an LLM-pretraining paper, but it is relevant to embodied foundation models and the design of action tokens or action conditions shared between human demonstrations and robot execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Contact Flow represents manipulation by trajectories of 3D contact points between an actor and a target object, deliberately removing actor-specific appearance and kinematics. This creates a shared conditioning signal for human and robot interaction videos, enabling a conditional video generative model to predict physically plausible manipulation outcomes and support a propose-and-verify planning loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that a large-scale video generative model is trained on both human and robotic object-interaction videos and used for manipulation prediction. It does not provide parameter count, dataset size, named baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Contact Flow 定义即可；它像 action tokenizer 设计笔记，实验信息不足，先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the Contact Flow definition; it is useful as an action-tokenizer design note, but the abstract gives too little experimental grounding.

paper.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
paper.abstract: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid" spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-lan

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是具身基础模型的数据组织问题：机器人预训练不能直接复用互联网文本和图像的规模化路径，因为它还需要状态、动作、接触、动力学和可执行监督。不同数据源在可扩展性、机器人对齐和物理真实性之间有明显取舍，但社区缺少一个稳定的分类框架来比较和组合这些数据。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对“多模态/具身预训练的数据配比”有启发。它把具身数据看成一个数据生态，而不是单一 robot trajectory 数据集问题。这个视角类似文本预训练里的 web、code、math、synthetic、high-quality corpus 配比问题：不同数据源提供不同训练信号，关键不只是数据量，而是信号是否能迁移到目标行为。局限也比较清楚：这是一篇数据中心视角的综述和框架整理，不提供新的 scaling law、训练配方或可复现实验结论。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是提出一个五层 Data Pyramid。自上而下分别是 real-robot data、UMI-style data、egocentric/exocentric human interaction data、simulation data、general vision-language data。排序依据是两个主轴：scalability 和 robot alignment。real-robot 数据最接近部署机器人，动作可直接执行，物理反馈真实，但采集成本高、重置和安全监督昂贵。UMI-style 数据去掉机器人本体，用手持或端执行器中心的采集方式保留操作轨迹，因此比真机数据更容易扩展，也比普通视频更接近可执行动作。ego/exo 视频覆盖人类交互、任务阶段和 affordance，但动作空间和机器人控制之间有映射缺口。simulation 可大规模生成带状态和动作的轨迹，但受资产、任务设计和 sim-to-real 差异限制。general vision-language 数据规模最大，提供语义和视觉先验，但缺少物理交互和动作监督。除两个主轴外，工作还用 quality、diversity、reusability、physical fidelity 四个维度解释为什么“更多数据”不一定带来更好的具身能力。
summary.experiments: 没有新的模型训练实验或严格消融。主要证据来自对已有 embodied foundation models 和代表性数据集的整理分析。文中强调的经验结论包括：真机数据的机器人对齐和物理真实性最高，但规模最受限；UMI-style 数据在可扩展性和可重定向性之间提供折中；人类第一/第三视角视频适合学习任务分解、手物交互和 affordance，但不能直接替代动作监督；仿真数据可控、便于自动生成失败和恢复轨迹，但物理细节、传感噪声和接触建模会影响迁移；通用图文/视频语言数据主要补语义和视觉知识，不能单独支撑操作策略学习。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 scalability 和 robot alignment 的定义，以及 Data Pyramid 的五层划分。图表部分如果包含数据集分布、不同数据源维度比较、近期模型数据配方对照，值得快速扫一遍。对预训练研究员更有用的是它的数据组织语言：如何把数据源按训练信号拆开，而不是只按模态或采集设备命名。无需细读所有具身模型案例，除非正在设计 VLA 或机器人 foundation model 的数据 mixture。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a data organization problem for embodied foundation models. Robot pretraining cannot simply copy the internet-scale recipe used for language and vision, because embodied agents need supervision over states, actions, contacts, dynamics, and executable behavior. Existing data sources provide these signals with different trade-offs, but the field lacks a clear framework for comparing and combining them.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not central to text LLM pretraining, but it is useful for thinking about data mixtures in embodied and multimodal pretraining. Its main contribution is a data-centric taxonomy: different sources are treated as different supervision channels rather than as interchangeable data pools. This is close in spirit to mixture design in LLM pretraining, where web text, code, math, synthetic data, and curated corpora contribute different gradients. The limitation is that the paper is a survey and framework piece; it does not introduce a new training recipe, scaling result, or controlled empirical law.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a five-level Data Pyramid: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric human interaction data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. The two primary axes are scalability and robot alignment. Real-robot data is directly aligned with the platform that produced it and has high physical fidelity, but it is expensive to collect and reset. UMI-style data removes the robot from the collection loop while retaining end-effector-centric manipulation signals, making it more scalable than robot demonstrations and more actionable than ordinary video. Human ego/exo video captures task structure, affordances, and hand-object interaction, but lacks robot-native action labels. Simulation provides controllable state-action trajectories, with transfer limited by assets, task coverage, and sim-to-real gaps. General vision-language data supplies broad semantic and perceptual priors but weak physical and action supervision. The paper further characterizes each source by quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: There are no new controlled training experiments. The evidence is mainly an organized analysis of representative datasets and recent embodied foundation models. The key observations are qualitative: real-robot data has the strongest execution alignment but the weakest scalability; UMI-style demonstrations offer a practical middle ground for manipulation; human videos are reusable for task decomposition and affordance learning but need action grounding; simulation is scalable and controllable but constrained by physical mismatch; general vision-language data helps perception and semantics but cannot replace interaction data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the definitions of scalability and robot alignment, the five-layer pyramid, and any tables or figures comparing data sources and model data recipes. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the data-mixture vocabulary: which supervision signal each source provides, what it fails to provide, and why scale alone is insufficient. The long catalog of embodied models can be read selectively unless you are actively designing a VLA or robot foundation model data pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫数据金字塔和模型配方表；它不能直接迁移到 LLM，但能校准多模态预训练里的“规模 vs 对齐”取舍。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pyramid and recipe tables; it will not transfer directly to LLMs, but it calibrates the scale-versus-alignment tradeoff in multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: SceneActBench: Can Agents Act on the 3D Scenes They See?
paper.abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) agents increasingly use tools to act on 3D scenes rather than only describe them. Existing 3D benchmarks score textual responses or single-object operations, leaving agent action on complete multi-object 3D scenes under evaluated. We present SceneActBench, a benchmark for visually conditioned action across five 3D tasks under a unified agent-environment loop. Given PNG images or sampled video frames and, where applicable, supplied 3D assets, an agent acts on a 3D envi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作提出一个评测问题：VLM agent 能否根据图像或视频帧，在可执行的 3D 环境中完成多物体场景操作，而不只是回答文本问题或操作单个物体。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，主要价值在 VLM agent 评测。对多模态预训练研究的启发在于，现有图文或 3D VQA 指标很难衡量模型是否真正具备可执行的空间 grounding。SceneActBench 把输出落到 Blender/GLB 场景和几何指标上，可以作为检验 native multimodal model、tool-using VLM、video-to-3D reasoning 的下游压力测试。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 采用统一 agent-environment loop。agent 接收 PNG 图像或从视频采样得到的帧，必要时还会收到标准化后的 3D assets，然后通过 headless Blender 工具接口生成 JSON 或 GLB 输出。任务覆盖五类能力：Layout 要根据室内图像摆放家具位置和 yaw；Camera 测试自我中心视角和相机参数推理；Articulated 测试关节物体运动状态；Reconstruction 测试从视觉证据恢复形状；Dynamic 测试多物体动态场景。数据来自 3D-FRONT/M3DLayout、S2O articulated containers，以及低多边形动态场景资产。作者对资产做了居中、重定向、匿名命名和尺度标准化，避免坐标或文件名泄漏答案。评测使用隐藏 3D ground truth 和任务特定几何指标，例如 Layout 中用 Hungarian matching 和 surface distance 计算 ADD-S 类分数。
summary.experiments: SceneActBench 包含 210 个 source instances，构成 520 个 task cases：100 个 furnished rooms、100 个 articulated objects、10 个 multi-object dynamic scenes。作者评测了 11 个 proprietary VLM configurations，整体分数范围为 38.6 到 50.2。结果显示不同配置在五个任务上的优势不一致，aggregate score 之外还需要 case-level diagnostics 才能看出失败来源，例如物体漏放、姿态错误、相机估计偏差、关节状态误判或动态轨迹不一致。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Benchmark 设计、五个 task 的输入输出定义、固定 agent loop，以及 Appendix A.3 的 evaluator 规则。若关注 VLM agent 评测，可以细看 Figure 2 的交互流程和 Layout/Dynamic 的几何指标。若关注 LLM 预训练方法，可以跳过大部分 3D 数据整理细节，只保留一个问题意识：多模态模型的训练信号如果只来自 caption/VQA，很可能不足以支撑可执行的空间操作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces an executable benchmark for testing whether VLM agents can act on full multi-object 3D scenes from visual evidence, rather than only answer text questions or manipulate a single object.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to base-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful as an evaluation asset for multimodal agents. The main signal for pretraining researchers is that text-only or VQA-style 3D evaluation does not measure whether a model can convert visual observations into executable spatial actions. SceneActBench provides a pressure test for native multimodal models, tool-using VLMs, and video-to-3D reasoning systems by scoring generated 3D outputs against hidden geometric ground truth.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a fixed agent-environment loop. The agent receives PNG images or sampled video frames, and in some tasks standardized 3D assets, then controls headless Blender through a tool interface. Outputs are stored as JSON or GLB files and evaluated against hidden 3D ground truth. The five tasks are Layout, Camera, Articulated, Reconstruction, and Dynamic. They cover spatial grounding, egocentric camera reasoning, kinematic reasoning, shape recovery, and multi-object motion. The data is assembled from 3D-FRONT/M3DLayout, S2O articulated containers, and custom low-poly dynamic scenes. Assets are centered, reoriented, anonymized, and rescaled to remove leakage from coordinates or file names. Metrics are task-specific geometric measures; for Layout, the benchmark uses Hungarian matching and surface-distance-based ADD-S-style scoring.
summary_en.experiments: SceneActBench contains 210 source instances and 520 task cases: 100 furnished rooms, 100 articulated objects, and 10 multi-object dynamic scenes. The authors evaluate 11 proprietary VLM configurations. Overall scores range from 38.6 to 50.2. The task breakdown indicates that leading configurations fail in different ways, so aggregate scores alone are not sufficient. The diagnostics expose errors such as missing objects, incorrect pose or yaw, camera misestimation, wrong articulated states, and inconsistent dynamic trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark formulation, the five task definitions, the fixed agent loop, and the evaluator rules in Appendix A.3. For VLM-agent evaluation work, Figure 2 and the geometric metrics for Layout and Dynamic are the most useful parts. For LLM pretraining work, most dataset-processing details can be skipped; the main takeaway is that captioning and VQA supervision may not be enough to train models that can perform executable spatial actions.

recommendation.zh: VLM具身评测方向的新基准，仅看§3任务定义与§5失败模式分析即可，对预训练本身无直接方法论启示。
recommendation.en: A new benchmark for VLM embodied evaluation; only read §3 task definition and §5 failure mode analysis, no direct methodological insight for pretraining.

paper.title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
paper.abstract: Action-conditioned world models are a key component of embodied AI, serving as scalable policy evaluators that reduce reliance on expensive real-world rollouts. To accurately capture diverse action-induced dynamics, such models should satisfy three key objectives-Physical Plausibility (P), Action Adherence (A), and Visual Fidelity (V), collectively referred to as PAV-while remaining robust to both in-distribution (ID) expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. However, existing

summary.core_problem: 训练动作条件视觉世界模型时，如何让模型同时满足物理合理性、动作遵循性和视觉质量，并能处理专家数据之外的动作。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 embodied AI 世界模型的训练目标和 RL 框架设计；对 LLM 预训练不直接，但对“生成模型如何用 reward 信号补齐像素重建损失”有一定旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: PAVXploreRL 建在预训练 latent world model 上，用强化学习显式优化 Physical Plausibility、Action Adherence、Visual Fidelity 三类 reward；同时混合专家轨迹和噪声驱动的 OOD action exploration，减少模型只拟合专家动作分布的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调方法在 ID expert demonstrations 和 OOD actions 上评估世界模型的 PAV 表现，但未给出具体模型规模、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train action-conditioned visual world models that satisfy physical plausibility, action adherence, and visual fidelity, while generalizing beyond expert action distributions.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a reward-driven training framework for embodied visual world models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is somewhat relevant to how generative models can move beyond reconstruction losses using task-structured rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: PAVXploreRL starts from a pretrained latent world model and applies reinforcement learning to optimize three reward families: Physical Plausibility, Action Adherence, and Visual Fidelity. It combines expert in-distribution trajectories with noise-driven out-of-distribution action exploration.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims evaluation on both in-distribution expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution actions, focusing on the PAV objectives. The provided text does not specify model size, training-data scale, baseline list, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 设计和 OOD action exploration；若在想 RL 信号怎么改造生成式 world model，这篇可作弱参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward design and OOD action-exploration setup; it is a weak but relevant reference for RL-tuning generative world models.

paper.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
paper.abstract: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 VLA 机器人模型的数据规模问题：真实机器人遥操作数据昂贵、任务窄、环境重复，难以像 LLM 和 VLM 一样通过大规模预训练获得泛化能力。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的直接相关性有限，但对“跨模态行为模型如何做大规模预训练”有启发。它把非机器人 UMI 轨迹、自动语言标注、跨 embodiment 对齐组织成两阶段 recipe，类似于先学通用 action-generation prior，再用高质量机器人数据做 post-training alignment。这个思路和基座模型中的 pretrain-posttrain 接口相近，尤其值得关注其数据标注和 scaling 实验。
summary.technical_approach: 模型是端到端 vision-language-action policy，输入视觉观察和语言指令，输出 action chunk。训练分两阶段。预训练阶段使用超过 100k 小时真实世界 manipulation trajectories，主要来自 UMI 设备。由于人工切分和标注在这个规模下成本过高，作者使用预训练 VLM 自动给固定长度轨迹片段生成自然语言描述，描述的是场景状态变化，而不是传统的命令式任务标签。模型因此学习“从当前状态到语言指定目标状态”的动作生成能力。post-training 阶段使用超过 10k 小时 cross-embodiment 数据，把 UMI gripper 的动作 prior 对齐到真实机器人 embodiment，并把 state-transition prompt 对齐到人类常用的 imperative instruction。架构上采用 Mixture-of-Transformers，并以 Qwen3-VL 作为视觉语言 backbone 的一部分。
summary.experiments: 实验显示预训练阶段存在清晰 scaling 行为：数据和模型规模增加时，validation action error 下降。更重要的是，这种预训练阶段的优势会传递到 post-training 后的真实机器人成功率。少样本适配实验中，在四个复杂 dexterous tasks 上，每个任务平均少于 10 小时数据，Xiaomi-Robotics-1 平均成功率为 75%，对比 π0.5 的 40%。仿真评测覆盖 RoboCasa、RoboCasa365、VLABench 和 RoboDojo。RoboCasa365 成功率为 57.6%，高于此前 46.6%；RoboDojo 平均分 20.07，高于此前 13.07。论文还展示了超过 10 分钟的房间级长程 suitcase packing 任务。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看数据构造和训练 recipe，而不是机器人 benchmark 排名。优先阅读 introduction 中对数据瓶颈的定义、Xiaomi-Robotics-1 章节中的两阶段训练、自动标注流程，以及 scaling 实验。对预训练研究更有用的问题是：自动生成的 state-transition captions 是否足够稳定；UMI 数据学到的 action prior 如何迁移到机器人 embodiment；validation action error 和真实任务成功率之间相关性有多强。
summary.authors_note: 小米机器人团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the data-scaling bottleneck for vision-language-action robotics models: real-robot teleoperation is expensive, hardware-bound, and often narrow in task and environment diversity.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, but it is useful as a case study in large-scale multimodal action pretraining. The paper separates broad action-prior learning from embodiment and instruction alignment, which resembles the pretraining-to-posttraining interface used in foundation models. The most relevant parts are the trajectory auto-labeling pipeline, the use of state-transition language as supervision, and the scaling experiments showing that better pretraining transfers to better post-training performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is an end-to-end VLA policy that maps visual observations and language prompts to action chunks. Training has two stages. In pretraining, the model uses more than 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected with UMI devices. Since manual segmentation and annotation would not scale, the authors use a pretrained VLM to label fixed-length trajectory clips with natural-language descriptions of scene state transitions. This changes the supervision format from imperative task labels to descriptions of how the scene changes. The model learns to generate actions that move the scene from the current state toward the language-specified target state. In post-training, more than 10k hours of cross-embodiment robot data are used to align the UMI-derived action prior to robot embodiments and to convert state-transition prompting into human-style instructions. The model uses a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and incorporates Qwen3-VL as part of its vision-language backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports scaling behavior during pretraining: larger models and more data reduce validation action error. This pretraining advantage transfers to post-training, where stronger pretrained models achieve higher real-robot success rates in unseen environments. In low-data adaptation, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 reaches an average success rate of 75% across four complex dexterous tasks with less than 10 hours of data per task on average, compared with 40% for π0.5. The model is also evaluated on RoboCasa, RoboCasa365, VLABench, and RoboDojo. It reports 57.6% success on RoboCasa365 compared with a previous 46.6%, and an average RoboDojo score of 20.07 compared with 13.07. The paper also demonstrates a long-horizon room-level suitcase-packing task lasting more than 10 minutes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the data pipeline and training recipe rather than the robotics leaderboard numbers. The most useful parts are the motivation around robotics data scaling, the two-stage pretraining/post-training design, the VLM-based trajectory annotation pipeline, and the scaling plots connecting validation action error to downstream success. For pretraining researchers, the key questions are whether state-transition captions provide a stable training signal, how well a UMI-derived action prior transfers across embodiments, and how predictive offline action error is of real-world task success.
summary_en.authors_note: Xiaomi Robotics team.

recommendation.zh: 重点看自动标注流水线与两阶段训练recipe，具身多模态预训练的数据配比和监督形式可直接迁移到内部VLM实验。
recommendation.en: Focus on the auto-labeling pipeline and two-stage training recipe; the data mixture and supervision design for embodied VLA pretraining are directly transferable to internal VLM ablations.

paper.title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
paper.abstract: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagina

summary.core_problem: 把具身任务中的“语言规划”与“视觉想象/世界状态预测”统一到一个基础模型里，形成可执行的计划序列表示。
summary.importance: 属于多模态/具身统一建模方向：把 plan 表示成跨语言与视觉的序列，有潜力影响多模态预训练目标与 token 统一方式，但是否有扎实的预训练贡献取决于训练细节与规模。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hy-Embodied-RxBrain：用统一 planning sequence 表达计划；语言给出抽象结构（分解、约束、时序、决策逻辑），视觉“想象”负责中间/最终物理状态预测与子目标落地；采用 unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers 架构以支持语言/图像/视频理解与生成式想象。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露参数规模、预训练数据与训练配方；也未给出与主流 VLM/世界模型/具身基线的量化提升幅度，当前只能按“架构与表示思路”给中等相关性。

summary_en.core_problem: Unify language planning and visual imagination/world-state prediction into a single foundation model for embodied planning sequences.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to unified multimodal modeling for embodiment; could inform pretraining objectives and token unification, but the actual pretraining contribution hinges on missing scale/recipe details.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hy-Embodied-RxBrain represents plans as a single sequence: language encodes abstract plan structure (decomposition, constraints, temporal order, decision logic) while visual imagination predicts intermediate/final physical states and supports subgoal planning; uses a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture for language/image/video understanding and generation-like imagination.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model size, pretraining data/recipe, and quantified comparisons against strong VLM/world-model/embodied baselines, so relevance is mainly conceptual.

recommendation.zh: 把“计划=跨语言+视觉状态的单序列”讲得清楚，但训练规模与对比缺失；只读架构/表示那部分，别指望拿到可复用 recipe。
recommendation.en: The “plan as a single multimodal sequence” idea is clear, but scale/recipe and clean baselines are missing; read for representation/architecture only, not for reusable training recipes.

paper.title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstra

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的观测在相机坐标系、动作在机器人坐标系，跨视角泛化时存在帧不匹配问题，限制大规模多数据集训练后的泛化能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出机器人中心的pointmap输入表示，在最小架构改动下适配现有预训练2D VLA，提升跨视角泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 构造像素存储机器人帧下3D坐标的pointmap，既提供机器人坐标系的3D几何信息，又保留预训练VLA所需的密集HxW网格结构，可直接集成到现有VLA架构中。
summary.experiments: 在RoboCasa基准上，pointmap可提升pi0.5和SmolVLA的表现，优于代表性基线方法（摘要未完整披露具体提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models observe scenes in the camera frame but predict actions in the robot's coordinate frame, causing a frame mismatch that degrades generalization across diverse camera setups when training on large-scale multi-dataset demonstrations.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a robot-centric pointmap input representation that adapts to existing pretrained 2D VLAs with minimal architectural changes, improving cross-viewpoint generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs pointmaps where each pixel stores the 3D coordinate of the corresponding scene point in the robot frame, providing robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense HxW grid structure required by pretrained VLAs, enabling direct integration into existing VLA architectures.
summary_en.experiments: On the RoboCasa benchmark, pointmaps improve performance of both pi0.5 and SmolVLA, outperforming representative baseline methods (specific improvement margins are not fully disclosed in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: VLA输入表示的工程改进，仅针对机器人具身场景，对通用多模态预训练无直接启发，了解即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering improvement of VLA input representation for robot embodied scenarios, no direct insight for general multimodal pretraining, good to know.

paper.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
paper.abstract: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是通用图像/视频生成模型迁移到机器人场景时的失配问题：自然图像生成只需要视觉上合理，而具身生成还要求多视角一致、几何连贯、机器人本体约束和时间动态一致。作者的核心做法不是把基础生成模型窄化成机器人专用模型，而是把具身合成放回统一的多模态生成预训练框架里。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在两点。第一，它把机器人数据合成看成统一世界模型训练的一部分，而不是下游适配任务，这对多模态预训练的数据配比和任务设计有参考意义。第二，它强调继续训练时必须保留通用图像/视频生成任务，否则小规模、重复性强的机器人数据会削弱基础模型原有的语义和可控生成能力。贡献量级更偏系统整合和训练范式验证，不是新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 是一个 38B 参数的多模态自回归模型。它从已有 world foundation model 出发，在通用域数据和具身数据上做联合继续训练，统一优化 text-to-image、image editing、embodied scene generation、embodied transfer 和 embodied video generation。关键取舍是：不只用机器人轨迹继续训练，因为这会造成能力遗忘；也不只做单步场景生成，因为机器人策略需要可 rollout 的时序数据。论文进一步把 interleaved embodied sequences 和 manipulation videos 放到多时间分辨率下联合建模，用同一自回归框架同时覆盖静态多视角场景、结构化编辑迁移和视频 rollout。这个设计更像 Chameleon/Emu3/Janus 一类 unified autoregressive multimodal modeling 在机器人世界模型上的延伸。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的主要结果包括：在 embodied scene generation 和 embodied transfer 的人工评测中优于 GPT-Image-2.0；在 World Arena benchmark 上取得较强结果；生成数据能提升下游机器人策略的 out-of-distribution robustness。给定全文片段没有提供具体分数、胜率、数据规模、tokenizer 细节和训练配比，因此这些结论需要在实验表格中核对。对预训练研究更有信息量的实验不是视觉样例，而是：联合训练是否优于机器人数据单独继续训练，通用生成能力是否被保留，生成轨迹加入策略训练后在 OOD 条件下的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看三类内容：一是模型输入输出表示和自回归序列化方式，特别是图像、视频、多视角和机器人状态如何被组织成同一序列；二是训练数据与任务 mixture，尤其是通用生成任务和具身任务的比例、采样策略、loss 权重；三是 ablation，确认联合继续训练是否真的缓解遗忘，并带来机器人策略收益。定性图可以快速浏览，不应作为主要判断依据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete mismatch between foundation image/video generators and embodied generation. Natural image generation only needs plausible visual outputs, while robotic scenarios require multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, embodiment constraints, and temporally consistent interaction dynamics. The proposed direction is to treat embodied synthesis as part of unified multimodal generative pretraining, rather than as a narrow robot-only adaptation stage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the training recipe and task formulation. The work argues that robot-world modeling should remain coupled with general image and video generation tasks during continual training, because robot datasets are smaller, more repetitive, and less diverse than web-scale visual corpora. This is a useful lesson for multimodal foundation model training: domain specialization can easily trade away the broad controllability and semantic coverage that made the base model useful. The contribution is mainly a large-system formulation and empirical validation, not a new modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is described as a 38B multimodal autoregressive model. It starts from a world foundation model and continues training on both general-domain and embodied datasets under one autoregressive objective. The task mixture includes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. The important design choice is to avoid robot-only finetuning, which may cause capability forgetting, and to go beyond single-step scene synthesis by modeling interleaved embodied sequences and manipulation videos at multiple temporal resolutions. In spirit, it extends unified autoregressive multimodal modeling, as seen in systems such as Chameleon, Emu3, and Janus, into robot-centric world modeling.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports stronger human preference results than GPT-Image-2.0 on embodied scene generation and embodied transfer, strong performance on the World Arena benchmark, and improved out-of-distribution robustness for downstream robot policies when generated data is used. The provided content does not include exact scores, win rates, dataset sizes, tokenizer details, or mixture ratios. The most informative results to verify are the ablations: joint general-plus-embodied training versus robot-only continual training, preservation of general generation ability, and the magnitude of downstream policy gains from synthetic trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Focus on the representation and serialization scheme for images, videos, multi-view observations, and robot-conditioned inputs; the data and task mixture used during continual training; and the ablation tables around forgetting, embodied generation quality, and policy improvement. Qualitative galleries are useful for sanity checks but should not drive the main assessment.

recommendation.zh: 38B统一具身生成的系统工作，参考其多任务联合训练设置，以及复用通用预训练能力适配具身约束的设计思路。
recommendation.en: 38B unified embodied synthesis system work; reference its multi-task joint training setup and design for adapting general pretrained generation capabilities to embodied constraints.

paper.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
paper.abstract: The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. Nevertheless, we argue that repurposing video generative models designed for digital content creation is inherently inadequate for physical environments. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model built from the ground up for embodiment. Four core design principles showcase its evolution from LingBot-VA. (1) Departing from traditional reconstruction-focused VAEs, we introduce a semant

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是机器人控制里的 video-action foundation model 如何预训练。作者认为，把通用视频生成模型改造成机器人策略会有结构性错配：tokenizer 偏重像素重建，backbone 常用双向视频扩散，动作模块通常后接，难以把 web video 的规模转化为控制能力。LingBot-VA 2.0 试图从 tokenizer、预训练目标、时序因果结构和推理部署上重新设计 video-action 模型。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和 LLM 预训练的关系在于统一序列建模和跨模态 tokenizer，而不是传统机器人学习。它把视觉状态、潜在动作、语言条件放到一个可扩展的预训练框架中，并强调因果 next-latent 目标比双向重建式视频生成更贴近闭环控制。对基座研究的启发是：当新模态需要行动或物理动态时，tokenizer 不能只优化重建质量，预训练目标也不能只学外观连续性；表示需要对下游控制变量有对齐约束。
summary.technical_approach: LingBot-VA 2.0 有两个主要预训练阶段。第一阶段是 semantic visual-action tokenizer。它不只做 VAE 式重建，而是把视觉 latent 对齐到冻结视觉基础模型的语义空间，同时通过自监督学习 latent action，使世界状态和动作处在共享 latent space 中。这样，未标注 web video 也能提供和动作相关的监督。第二阶段是 causal diffusion transformer。模型以语言指令为条件，通过 cross-attention 接入冻结语言模型，预测未来视觉 latent 以及连接这些 latent 的潜在动作。作者采用因果 next-latent pretraining，而不是先训练双向视频生成模型再用机器人数据改成因果模型，以避免 temporal objective 和闭环控制之间的错配。架构上使用 sparse MoE feed-forward 来保留容量并降低每步激活计算。训练上加入 multi-chunk prediction，同时监督多个未来 chunk，减少模型只复制相邻帧外观的倾向，迫使 latent 携带更长程的轨迹动态。部署上引入 Foresight Reasoning：在机器人执行动作的同时异步预测未来 latent，并用最新真实观测通过 policy 的 forward-dynamics step 重新校正，避免纯想象 rollout 漂移。系统层面还结合 few-step consistency distillation、量化执行和层级 VLM planner。
summary.experiments: 论文声称 LingBot-VA 2.0 在仿真和真实机器人评测中优于 π0.5 与 LingBot-VA 等强基线。关键数字包括：下游适配只需约 10–15 条 demonstrations；可以跨 embodiment 迁移，部分设置下能 zero-shot 执行新任务；异步部署峰值执行频率达到 225 Hz。实验结论集中在三类收益：semantic visual-action tokenizer 改善指令跟随和动作精度；causal video-action pretraining 提升泛化和少样本适配；Foresight Reasoning、MoE、consistency distillation 与量化让模型能进入实时闭环控制。由于给出的内容未包含完整表格，具体任务成功率、消融幅度和统计方差需要以实验章节为准。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35–50 分钟。优先看四个部分：semantic visual-action tokenizer 的训练目标，causal DiT 的 next-latent / latent-action 预训练目标，multi-chunk prediction 的消融，以及 Foresight Reasoning 的异步推理机制。对预训练研究员，最值得深挖的是 tokenizer 为什么要同时对齐语义和动作，而不是只压缩视频；以及为什么因果预训练比双向视频 diffusion retrofit 更适合控制。实验部分重点看少样本适配、跨 embodiment、真实机器人频率和各模块消融，不必把它当作普通机器人 benchmark 论文来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how video-action foundation models should be pretrained for robot control. The authors argue that adapting generic video generators is structurally mismatched: reconstruction-oriented tokenizers preserve appearance rather than control-relevant structure, bidirectional video diffusion does not match causal closed-loop control, and action modules are often attached after the fact. LingBot-VA 2.0 redesigns the tokenizer, objective, temporal modeling, and inference path around embodiment from the start.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model pretraining lies in multimodal tokenization and causal sequence modeling, not in conventional robotics. The work treats visual states, latent actions, and language conditioning as parts of a scalable pretraining problem. A useful lesson is that new modalities with action and dynamics cannot rely on reconstruction quality alone. The tokenizer must align with downstream control variables, and the pretraining objective must capture how actions change future states rather than only modeling short-term visual continuity.
summary_en.technical_approach: LingBot-VA 2.0 has two central pretraining components. The first is a semantic visual-action tokenizer. Instead of optimizing only VAE-style reconstruction, it aligns visual latents with a frozen visual foundation model and learns latent actions through self-supervision, placing world states and actions in a shared latent space. This lets unlabeled web video provide action-relevant supervision. The second component is a causal diffusion transformer. Conditioned on language instructions via cross-attention to a frozen pretrained language model, it predicts future visual latents and the latent actions connecting them. The causal next-latent objective is chosen instead of retrofitting a bidirectional video generator, because robot control unfolds forward in time. The backbone uses sparse MoE feed-forward layers to keep capacity while reducing active compute. The training objective adds multi-chunk prediction, supervising several future chunks at once so that the model learns trajectory-level dynamics rather than copying adjacent-frame appearance. For deployment, Foresight Reasoning runs future-latent prediction asynchronously with action execution and re-grounds predictions on the latest real observation through a learned forward-dynamics step. The system also uses few-step consistency distillation, quantized execution, and a hierarchical VLM planner for long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports improvements over strong baselines such as π0.5 and the previous LingBot-VA in simulation and real-robot settings. Reported operating points include adaptation from roughly 10–15 demonstrations, transfer across embodiments, zero-shot execution in some settings, and a peak asynchronous execution frequency of 225 Hz. The claimed gains come from three sources: the semantic visual-action tokenizer improves instruction following and action precision; causal video-action pretraining improves generalization and data efficiency; and Foresight Reasoning together with MoE, consistency distillation, and quantization makes real-time closed-loop deployment feasible. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact success rates and ablation deltas should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim to semi-close read in about 35–50 minutes. Focus on the semantic visual-action tokenizer, the causal DiT next-latent and latent-action objectives, the multi-chunk prediction ablation, and the Foresight Reasoning inference design. For pretraining researchers, the main points to inspect are why the tokenizer is aligned to both semantics and actions rather than optimized only for video compression, and why native causal pretraining is preferred over adapting a bidirectional video diffusion model. In the experiments, prioritize few-shot adaptation, embodiment transfer, real-robot frequency, and module-level ablations.

recommendation.zh: 只看 tokenizer 与 causal pretraining 设计；机器人指标可略过，但它会影响我对 embodied tokenization 的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the tokenizer and causal-pretraining design; skip most robotics metrics, but it should update priors on embodied tokenization.

paper.title: WildCity: A Real-World City-Scale Testbed for Rendering, Simulation, and Spatial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Humans can navigate an unfamiliar city and gradually form a coherent spatial mental map spanning tens of square kilometers. Can AI build spatial representations at a comparable scale? Although recent foundation models have advanced scene reconstruction and embodied intelligence, scaling to entire cities remains an open challenge, primarily due to the lack of city-scale data. To bridge the gap, we introduce WildCity, a real-world multimodal dataset collected by autonomous fleets traversing comple

summary.core_problem: 缺少真实城市尺度数据导致“可用于闭环仿真/空间智能”的城市级数字孪生难以扩展，如何提供数据与测试床来系统化暴露瓶颈。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是城市尺度多模态数据集+重建baseline+闭环模拟器与挑战分析；对具身/空间智能与未来多模态预训练数据形态有参考，但不是直接的LLM预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 发布WildCity：由自动驾驶车队采集的真实城市多模态轨迹数据（含动态物体、光照变化、位姿误差等真实噪声）；提供面向城市环境的重建baseline，并将重建环境转为可闭环交互的模拟器；同时对“走向可仿真的城市数字孪生”关键挑战做系统分析。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：18条轨迹，平均每条83.7km；提供城市重建baseline与仿真闭环设置。摘要未给出具体重建指标、对比SOTA或误差分解表。
summary.authors_note: Cohere（摘要标注 strong institution）

summary_en.core_problem: City-scale simulation-ready digital twins and spatial intelligence are bottlenecked by the lack of real-world city-scale data; how to provide a testbed that exposes the real failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Main contribution is a city-scale multimodal dataset plus reconstruction baselines and a closed-loop simulator, along with a challenge analysis; relevant as a data/eval asset for embodied/spatial intelligence, but not a direct LLM pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: WildCity: real-world multimodal trajectories collected by autonomous fleets, preserving in-the-wild nuisances (dynamic objects, lighting changes, imperfect poses). The paper provides an urban-tailored reconstruction baseline, converts reconstructions into a closed-loop simulator, and analyzes key challenges toward simulation-ready urban digital twins.
summary_en.experiments: Scale: 18 trajectories averaging 83.7 km each; includes reconstruction baseline and closed-loop simulation setup. The abstract does not report detailed reconstruction metrics or strong SOTA comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: Cohere (flagged as a strong institution in the prompt)

recommendation.zh: 把它当“未来空间/具身预训练数据长什么样”的样板看：只读数据采集噪声建模与挑战分析部分，别指望直接给LLM recipe。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a template for what future spatial/embodied pretraining data may look like; skim the data nuisances + challenge analysis, not for LLM recipes.

paper.title: Vision Language Action (VLA) Models for Unmanned Aerial Robotics and Bimanual Manipulation: A Review
paper.abstract: Vision Language Action (VLA) models unify visual perception, natural-language understanding, and action generation within a single foundation model, allowing a robot to follow instructions such as fold the towel or fly to the red building directly from camera images. Because VLAs inherit world knowledge from internet-scale pre-training, they have become the dominant framework for learning-based manipulation, with bimanual coordination serving as the most demanding testbed: two arms with 7 degree

summary.core_problem: 综述 Vision-Language-Action 模型在无人机机器人和双臂操作中的架构、训练配方、动作表示和系统约束。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是领域综述。它对预训练研究员的价值主要在于整理 VLA 如何把视觉、语言和动作放进统一模型，以及 action representation、延迟、负载和双臂协调这些具身场景对基础模型接口提出的约束。
summary.technical_approach: 论文覆盖 2017-2026 年的 183 篇工作，并按七个维度组织：VLA 架构、训练 recipe、动作表示、双臂协调、无人机相关 VLA、部署约束与未来方向。它不是提出新模型，而是比较不同 VLA 系统如何从视觉观测和语言指令生成连续或离散动作。
summary.experiments: 作为综述论文，没有统一新实验或模型训练结果。摘要强调双臂任务需要两个 7 自由度机械臂协同完成折叠、装配、重定向等操作；无人机任务则需要在严格延迟和载荷约束下协调推力、姿态和可能的夹爪控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The review surveys Vision-Language-Action models for unmanned aerial robotics and bimanual manipulation, focusing on architectures, training recipes, action representations, and deployment constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is a domain review. Its value for pretraining researchers is in mapping how vision, language, and action are unified in VLA systems, and how action representation, latency, payload, and bimanual coordination stress the foundation-model interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper covers 183 contributions from 2017 to 2026 and organizes them along seven dimensions, including VLA architectures, training recipes, action representations, bimanual coordination, UAV-oriented VLA work, deployment constraints, and future directions. It does not propose a new model; it compares how VLA systems map visual observations and language instructions to actions.
summary_en.experiments: As a review, it reports no unified new experiments or model-training results. The abstract highlights bimanual manipulation with two 7-DoF arms for folding, assembly, and reorientation, and UAV tasks that require coordinating thrust, attitude, and sometimes gripper commands under strict latency and payload limits.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLA/action tokenization 目录可留档；不必细读，重点翻动作表示和训练 recipe 分类表。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLA and action-tokenization map; skip the prose and inspect the action-representation and training-recipe taxonomy.

paper.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
paper.abstract: We present EmbodiedGen V2, a generative 3D world engine for building executable sim-ready environments for embodied intelligence. Sim-ready 3D asset generation has advanced rapidly, yet assembling such assets into policy-ready task environments remains largely manual, limiting scalable closed-loop learning. EmbodiedGen V2 addresses this gap through a unified sim-ready representation that connects cross-simulator assets, interaction affordances, task-driven worlds, large-scale multi-room scenes,

summary.core_problem: 可交互、可训练的 embodied AI 环境仍主要依赖人工搭建，限制了闭环策略学习的数据规模。
summary.importance: 贡献是 3D 世界生成与 embodied AI 训练系统：把生成式 3D 资产、交互 affordance、任务场景、多房间环境和跨模拟器部署连接成可复用的 sim-ready pipeline。它和通用 agent 数据生成有弱相关，但不是 LLM 基座预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: EmbodiedGen V2 提出统一的 sim-ready 表示，覆盖跨模拟器资产、可交互属性、任务驱动世界、大规模多房间场景，以及带状态的 Vibe Coding 编辑流程。生成环境可用于操作、导航、移动操作、跨模拟器部署和 embodied policy training。
summary.experiments: 资产 pipeline 达到 96.5% human acceptance 和 98.6% collision success；83.3% 任务驱动世界无需人工修改即可用于下游模拟。摘要还称用生成环境做 online reinforcement learning 可提升策略训练，但未给出具体任务、模型和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Executable, interaction-ready environments for embodied AI are still largely built by hand, limiting the scale of closed-loop policy learning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a 3D world generation and embodied-AI training system. It connects generative 3D assets, affordances, task-driven scenes, multi-room worlds, and cross-simulator deployment into a reusable sim-ready pipeline. It is loosely relevant to agent data generation, but not to LLM foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EmbodiedGen V2 introduces a unified sim-ready representation spanning cross-simulator assets, interaction affordances, task-driven worlds, large multi-room scenes, and stateful Vibe Coding. The generated environments support manipulation, navigation, mobile manipulation, cross-simulator deployment, and embodied policy training.
summary_en.experiments: The asset pipeline reports 96.5% human acceptance and 98.6% collision success. The authors state that 83.3% of task-driven worlds are directly usable for downstream simulation without manual edits. The abstract also reports gains from online RL in generated environments, but does not specify tasks, policies, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 可看作 embodied agent 数据引擎信号；读指标和环境可用性即可，和 LLM 预训练仍隔一层。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a signal for embodied-agent data engines; read the usability metrics, but it remains one step away from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
paper.abstract: World models -- internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment -- have become one of the most actively debated concepts in AI. From model-based reinforcement learning and video generation to embodied robotics and ultimately, physical AI, researchers across AI subfields are building systems that they call "world models", yet there is no consensus on what a world model fundamentally is, what it should predict, or how it should be built. This perspective article provide

summary.core_problem: 给“world model”一个可操作的科学定义，并提出一条分阶段的研发路线图，试图解决该概念在 RL、视频生成、机器人与生成建模社区中被混用、难以对齐的问题。全文的核心落点不是提出新训练目标或新架构，而是统一讨论：世界模型到底在压缩什么分布、应该预测什么、以及数据规模与多样性在其中的决定性作用。
summary.importance:
对 LLM 基座预训练的直接方法贡献较弱（偏观点/路线图），但对“跨模态统一预训练/视频-动作建模/物理世界建模”的研究取向有启发：
- 把 world model 视为对“感知观测 + 动作”的联合分布做最大压缩的机制，强调压缩带来的语义抽象 vs 物理细节保真之间的连续权衡。
- 强调数据多样性决定泛化上限（引用 Training Compute-Optimal 观点），并提出优先利用互联网视频的规模优势，再逐步蒸馏到任务对齐的具身数据（Inverted Pyramid Workflow）。
这些观点会影响预训练数据策略（先广覆盖再窄对齐）、表征学习目标（像素重建 vs 潜空间预测）、以及“视频作为物理先验载体”的数据工程优先级。
summary.technical_approach:
文章是 perspective，不给出单一可复现算法；技术内容主要是概念框架与工程路线：
- 批评仅按输出形式分类（renderer/simulator/planner）的功能分类法：同一个内部表征可以被不同解码头投影到像素、状态或动作建议，关键在于共享内部表征如何学到。
- 讨论 LeCun 式观点（不做像素级生成、只做 latent prediction / joint embedding）与生成式重建之间的取舍：作者倾向认为像素重建不是终点，但重建质量能作为“信息丢失诊断工具”，帮助判断压缩表征遗漏了哪些物理因素。
- 提出 compression-centered view：世界模型学习的是现实世界传感观测与动作的联合分布的压缩；压缩必然带来表征在高层语义与低层动力学/感知保真之间的权衡。
- Inverted Pyramid Workflow：以互联网视频为底座获取最大多样性物理经验，通过自动过滤与标注“解锁”隐含物理先验，再逐步漏斗式蒸馏为更紧凑、动作表征更标准化、与机器人任务更对齐的数据集。其论点是：架构与算力影响逼近上限的效率，但数据多样性抬升上限。
summary.experiments: 无核心实验与量化结果（观点文章）。文中更多是论证与例子：互联网视频包含大量隐式物理先验（物体恒常性、刚体/非刚体约束、遮挡因果、光照阴影时序等），但像素空间难以直接显式化，需要“目的性压缩机制”提取结构。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看定义与争议点澄清：他们如何界定 world model、为何认为“输出分类”不够。
- 看 compression-centered view 的论证：它如何把重建/潜空间预测之争落到“信息保留诊断”与“表征权衡”。
- 看 Inverted Pyramid Workflow：把它当作数据路线图而非算法，思考与现有视频预训练、具身数据合成/标注管线的接口。
如果目标是改进 LLM/多模态预训练 recipe，这篇更适合作为数据策略与目标函数取舍的讨论材料，而不是直接照搬实现。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a precise, scientific definition of “world models” and a staged roadmap, addressing the fact that the term is used inconsistently across model-based RL, video generation, robotics, and generative modeling. The paper is primarily about clarifying what a world model represents and how it should be built, rather than proposing a new trainable algorithm.
summary_en.importance:
Weak direct contribution to LLM pretraining methods, but useful as a framing for multimodal/foundation pretraining that targets physical understanding:
- Treats a world model as a compression mechanism for the joint distribution of sensory observations and actions, making the abstraction–fidelity trade-off explicit.
- Argues that data diversity sets the generalization ceiling (architecture/compute affect efficiency, not the ceiling), motivating an internet-video-first data strategy.
- Proposes an “Inverted Pyramid” data workflow: start from broad web video, unlock latent physical priors via automated filtering/annotation, then distill into compact, task-aligned embodied datasets.
These ideas can influence pretraining data mixture strategy and the choice between pixel reconstruction and latent-space prediction objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
As a perspective piece, it offers conceptual and engineering frameworks rather than a single reproducible method:
- Critiques function-based taxonomies (renderer/simulator/planner) as classifying decoders rather than the shared internal representation; the same internal model can be queried/decoded in multiple ways.
- Discusses the latent-prediction/joint-embedding stance (e.g., LeCun) versus generative reconstruction: reconstruction is not the end goal, but it can serve as a diagnostic for what information a compressed representation fails to preserve.
- Introduces a compression-centered definition: world models aim to maximally compress the joint distribution over real-world observations and agent actions; lossy compression induces a continuum between high-level semantics and fine-grained physical dynamics/perceptual fidelity.
- Presents the Inverted Pyramid Workflow as a data roadmap: leverage the scale/diversity of internet video to extract broad physical priors, then progressively filter/standardize action representations and distill into smaller, task-aligned datasets for robotics.
summary_en.experiments: No central experiments or quantitative results (non-empirical roadmap paper). The text motivates the approach by enumerating physical priors implicitly present in web video (object permanence, rigidity constraints, occlusion causality, lighting dynamics, etc.) and argues that pixel space hides these factors, requiring purpose-built compression/representation learning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the definition section and the critique of output-based taxonomies to understand what they consider the “internal model.”
- Focus on the compression-centered argument and how it reframes reconstruction vs latent prediction as an information-retention trade-off.
- Read the Inverted Pyramid Workflow as a data strategy blueprint; map it to existing video pretraining and embodied data pipelines.
Use it as guidance for data/objective choices, not as an implementation recipe.

recommendation.zh: 对 'World Model' 概念的系统性梳理和定义，有助于澄清当前多模态预训练和具身智能中被滥用的术语，建议快速浏览其 Roadmap 划分。
recommendation.en: A systematic review and definition of the 'World Model' concept, helping to clarify the often-abused terminology in current multimodal pretraining and embodied AI. Recommend skimming its Roadmap stages.

paper.title: WorldBagel: Uncovering the Power of Unified Multimodal Models for Vision-Language-Action-World Modeling
paper.abstract: World models aim to capture environment dynamics in ways that support perception, reasoning, and action, and have recently become a central direction in Vision-Language-Action-World (VLAW) modeling. Meanwhile, unified vision-language models have demonstrated strong multimodal generation capabilities, yet their potential as world models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce \texttt{WorldBagel}, a unified VLAW framework built on BAGEL, a modern multimodal unified model, and use it to s

summary.core_problem: 现有研究存在两条割裂的路线：世界模型侧重视觉动力学建模但未深度融合语言与大规模多模态知识，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型侧重动作预测但未显式建模环境动力学；同时，BAGEL这类双塔结构的统一多模态模型，能否作为通用的视觉-语言-动作-世界（VLAW）基座、如何适配具身建模需求，缺乏系统验证与方案。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发包括：统一多模态预训练的双塔（理解+生成）专家架构，可直接扩展到具身世界建模场景，无需新增动作专属模块；连续动作的傅里叶token化、异构多模态数据的自适应重加权（借鉴自LLM预训练）两类设计，可迁移到通用具身多模态基座的训练流程；统一建模确实能提升分布偏移下的表征鲁棒性，为具身多模态的scaling策略提供实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 基于BAGEL的双塔（UND理解专家+GEN生成专家）架构扩展出WorldBagel，核心改动有三点：1）傅里叶特征动作tokenizer：将连续控制信号映射到共享多模态token空间，复用现有双塔路由机制处理动作相关任务，不新增动作专家；2）交错序列计划建模：将视觉观测、语言指令、动作token、未来帧预测按多种随机采样的顺序组织为自回归序列，联合完成多目标训练；3）自适应数据集重加权：借鉴多模态预训练的采样策略，稳定异构机器人多任务数据的训练过程，提升跨任务鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 在LIBERO、Language Table、Franka三个机器人操作基准上完成验证：1）多任务操作表现优于多种强VLA基线；2）傅里叶动作模块提升动作预测准确率，特征值谱分析验证其动作嵌入的结构更规整、信息量更高；3）在动作动力学分布偏移的测试场景下，未来世界状态预测更稳定，表征的结构丰富度优于任务专属模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分的傅里叶动作tokenizer设计、序列计划的采样规则，以及第4节的分布偏移实验与表征分析内容；可跳过原BAGEL架构的底层实现细节。预计阅读时间25-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Two research lines remain disconnected: world models focus on visual dynamics modeling but barely integrate language or large-scale multimodal knowledge, while vision-language-action (VLA) models prioritize action prediction without explicit environment dynamics modeling. Meanwhile, there is no systematic validation or framework for adapting dual-tower unified multimodal models (such as BAGEL) as general vision-language-action-world (VLAW) bases for embodied scenarios.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers three transferable insights: dual-expert (understanding + generation) unified multimodal pretraining architectures can be extended to embodied world modeling without dedicated action modules; Fourier-based continuous action tokenization and adaptive heterogeneous data reweighting (borrowed from LLM pretraining) are applicable to general embodied multimodal foundation model training; unified modeling improves representation robustness under distribution shifts, providing empirical support for scaling strategies of embodied multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldBagel extends BAGEL's two-tower (UND understanding expert + GEN generation expert) architecture with three core modifications: 1) A Fourier feature action tokenizer maps continuous control signals to the shared multimodal token space, reusing existing tower routing for action-related tasks without adding an extra action expert; 2) An interleaved sequence-plan framework organizes observations, language instructions, action tokens, and future frame predictions into autoregressive sequences with multiple randomly sampled orderings for joint multi-objective training; 3) An adaptive dataset reweighting strategy adapted from multimodal pretraining stabilizes training on heterogeneous multi-task robotic corpora and improves cross-task robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three robotic manipulation benchmarks (LIBERO, Language Table, Franka): 1) Multi-task manipulation performance surpasses multiple strong VLA baselines; 2) The Fourier action module improves action prediction accuracy, with eigenvalue spectrum analysis confirming more structured and informative action embeddings; 3) Under test scenarios with shifted action dynamics, the model produces more stable future world state predictions and retains richer representation structure than task-specific alternatives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Methodology) for the Fourier action tokenizer design and sequence-plan sampling rules, plus Section 4's distribution shift experiments and representation analysis. Skip low-level implementation details of the original BAGEL architecture. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 统一多模态建模向具身世界模型延伸的实证，关注§4中统一架构vs任务拆分的消融即可。
recommendation.en: Empirical study extending unified multimodal modeling to embodied world models; focus on §4 ablations comparing unification vs. task-specific splits.

paper.title: iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni Technical Report
