paper.title: Embodied3DBench: Benchmarking Low-Level Embodied Spatial Intelligence of Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Are current Vision Language Models (VLMs) ready to comprehend and reason about complex embodied interactions in 3D environments? We introduce Embodied3DBench, a robot-centric benchmark targeting low-level spatial intelligence in embodied 3D environments. To systematically evaluate these foundational perceptual capabilities, the benchmark includes 6 task categories divided into two core groups: Spatial Structural Understanding (Grounding, Spatial Relation Prediction, and Multi-view Correspondence

summary.core_problem: 评测当前 VLM 是否具备机器人视角下的低层 3D 空间理解和交互感知能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark / evaluation asset。它把 VLM 空间能力评测从高层语义问答推进到更贴近 embodied interaction 的低层能力，包括 grounding、空间关系、多视角对应、affordance、抓取点和轨迹预测。对多模态预训练研究的价值在于暴露现有图文模型在交互导向 perception 上的系统短板。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Embodied3DBench，一个 robot-centric 3D benchmark。任务分为两组：Spatial Structural Understanding，包括 grounding、spatial relation prediction、multi-view correspondence；Interaction-Oriented Perception，包括 affordance prediction、grasp point prediction、trajectory prediction。数据覆盖 6 类任务、12 个子类和超过 21k 高质量问答对。
summary.experiments: 评测 13 个当前主流 VLM。摘要结论是：模型在对象间位置关系等高层空间推理上相对较强，但在 affordance、抓取点和轨迹等交互导向感知上脆弱。摘要未给出具体模型名单、绝对分数或各任务提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Nan Duan；摘要未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark asks whether current VLMs can handle low-level 3D spatial understanding and interaction-centric perception from a robot-centered viewpoint.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset. It moves VLM spatial evaluation beyond high-level semantic QA toward embodied interaction skills, including grounding, spatial relations, multi-view correspondence, affordances, grasp points, and trajectories. For multimodal pretraining, the useful signal is the gap between image-language competence and interaction-ready perception.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embodied3DBench is organized around two groups of tasks: Spatial Structural Understanding, covering grounding, spatial relation prediction, and multi-view correspondence; and Interaction-Oriented Perception, covering affordance prediction, grasp point prediction, and trajectory prediction. The benchmark contains 6 task categories, 12 subcategories, and more than 21k QA pairs.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 13 contemporary VLMs. The abstract reports that models are relatively strong at high-level spatial reasoning such as object-to-object relations, but fragile on interaction-oriented perception such as affordances, grasping, and trajectories. Exact model names, scores, and margins are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Nan Duan; the abstract does not provide affiliation details.

recommendation.zh: 对 native multimodal 预训练有用，重点看任务切分和错误分布；不要把 3D QA 分数误读成可操作的机器人能力。
recommendation.en: Useful for native multimodal pretraining: read the task taxonomy and error patterns, but do not overread 3D QA scores as operational robotics competence.

paper.title: Emergent Semantic Representations in World Models through Physical Interaction without Linguistic Supervision
paper.abstract: What does a world model learn from physical exploration, without any linguistic supervision? We argue the answer is organized by a single principle: the geometric structure of the physical world. Training a VAE-based world model on random embodied exploration, we find that its latent space develops spatial semantic structure that mirrors physical geometry -- direction accuracy 0.677+-0.029 versus 0.547 for a randomly initialized encoder, and position RSA 0.192+-0.047 versus 0.029 for random enco

summary.core_problem: 探索世界模型在没有任何语言监督的情况下，仅通过物理随机探索，能否在潜空间中自发涌现出空间语义结构（如方向和位置）。
summary.importance: 为“具身经验先于语言”的认知发展理论提供了计算证据，表明物理几何结构是组织世界模型表征的核心驱动力，对理解多模态预训练中视觉与语言的对齐机制有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在简单的网格世界（MiniGrid）中，训练一个基于 VAE 的世界模型（包含图像编码器和转移模型）。智能体执行纯随机策略收集数据。通过表征相似度分析（RSA）和线性探测（Linear Probing），评估潜空间表征与物理空间几何结构（方向、位置）的对齐程度。通过调整 KL 散度权重（β）进行双重敲除实验，验证预测性能与语义对齐的共同驱动机制。
summary.experiments: 物理训练使潜空间的 RSA 得分比随机初始化编码器高 6.6 倍（0.192 vs 0.029）。线性探测显示方向准确率达到 0.677。预测损失与语义对齐在训练过程中协同改善（r = -0.61）。当 KL 权重过大导致后验坍塌时，预测性能和语义对齐同时崩溃，证实了两者共享几何驱动机制。位置结构的涌现早于方向结构。
summary.reading_guide: 建议关注 Method 部分的实验设计（特别是 RSA 的计算方式）以及双重敲除实验的逻辑。预计阅读时间 10 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates whether a world model can spontaneously develop spatial semantic structure (direction and position) in its latent space purely through physical random exploration, without any linguistic supervision.
summary_en.importance: Provides computational evidence for the developmental theory that grounded experience precedes language. It highlights physical geometry as a core organizing principle for world model representations, offering insights into the alignment mechanisms in multimodal pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a VAE-based world model (image encoder + transition model) in a simple grid world (MiniGrid) using a purely random exploration policy. Evaluates the alignment between latent representations and physical geometry using Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) and linear probing. Conducts a double-knockout experiment by tuning the KL divergence weight (β) to verify the shared driver mechanism between prediction performance and semantic alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Physical training increases the RSA score by 6.6x compared to a random encoder (0.192 vs 0.029). Linear probing achieves 0.677 accuracy for direction. Prediction loss and semantic alignment co-improve during training (r = -0.61). When a high KL weight induces posterior collapse, both prediction and semantics fail simultaneously, confirming the shared geometric driver. Spatial structure emerges before directional structure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental design in the Method section (especially the RSA computation) and the logic behind the double-knockout experiment. Estimated reading time: 10 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关于世界模型表征学习的机制分析，验证了预测目标能自发促成几何结构的涌现，对理解多模态预训练的表征有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Mechanism analysis on representation learning in world models, verifying that prediction objectives spontaneously foster the emergence of geometric structures, offering some inspiration for understanding representations in multimodal pre-training.

paper.title: What-If World: A Causal Benchmark for General World Models in Embodied Scenarios
paper.abstract: Video generation models are increasingly used as world simulators for tasks like driving and robotic manipulation. What matters in these settings is not whether a single video looks right, but whether the model's output changes when its input changes. We test this by giving a model two prompts describing the same scene with one physical detail varied, and checking whether the two videos diverge the way physics predicts. The wording difference between the prompts is small by design, since only on

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注一个现有视频世界模型评测几乎没有正面测到的问题：模型是否会随着输入中的受控物理变量变化而产生相应变化。现有 benchmark 往往逐条视频独立打分，只检查单个输出是否“看起来合理”，却无法发现一种更关键的失败模式——两条只改了一个物理条件的 prompt，模型却生成几乎一样的视频。对于自动驾驶、机器人操作、基于模型的规划和策略训练，这种 failure 比单视频不够真实更严重，因为它意味着模型没有学到可操控、可比较的因果响应。
summary.importance: 对预训练和统一世界模型研究的启发比较直接。它把“世界模型好不好”从视觉逼真度转向因果敏感性，尤其是对 intervention 的差分响应。这会影响未来视频生成或 action-conditioned world model 的训练目标、数据构造和评测协议：如果训练只优化单样本 realism，很可能学到的是视觉模板，而不是可用于规划的动力学响应。贡献量级属于中等：它不是新架构，但 benchmark 设计抓住了一个被主流评测忽略的核心能力，而且实验显示现有强模型在这一点上普遍偏弱。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由 benchmark 构建和 paired evaluation 两部分组成。第一部分是 What-If World 数据集。作者先定义什么样的物理干预变量适合做对比测试，并由两位领域专家在真实视频上筛选与归并，最后得到横跨自动驾驶和机械臂操作的六类 primitive：环境相关包括 surface friction、material/medium、obstacle configuration，动作相关包括 spatial alignment、force/degree、temporal sequencing。每个测试样本不是单 prompt，而是一个 paired triplet：同一初始帧 x0，加上一对只在一个语义变量上不同的 prompt。构建流程分三步：从 nuScenes 或 DROID 过滤出满足条件的真实片段；抽取动作开始前一帧并配上共享的场景描述；再人工写出只改一个干预变量的 prompt pair。这样做的目的，是尽量用文本设计近似 ceteris paribus，让输出差异能归因到该干预。第二部分是 APEO 评测框架。它把 paired generation 的好坏拆成四项：Adherence，干预是否被执行；Physics，动力学是否合理；Environment，非干预场景是否保持稳定；Outcome，成对输出是否按预期发生差异。前三项既看单视频也看成对视频，Outcome 只在 paired 模式下定义。这个拆分很有用，因为它能区分“没执行干预”“执行了但没拉开差异”“差异来自场景漂移”三种不同失败。评测实现依赖 VLM judge，并用人工标注做了验证。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个当前视频生成世界模型，其中 4 个开源、5 个闭源。最关键的结果有三点。第一，没有模型在 paired metric 上超过 52%，4 个开源模型集中在约 28% 左右，说明因果敏感性远未过关。第二，单视频评测与 paired 评测之间存在明显落差，作者把它称为 contrastive bottleneck：模型能分别生成两条看起来都合理的视频，但无法让它们按输入差异正确分化。第三，模型表现更像依赖“后果是否显眼”，而不是稳定掌握物理机制。比如 Force/Degree 这类会带来明显运动差异的干预，得分可到 40.4%；而 Surface Friction 这类只带来细微轨迹变化的干预，得分只有 14.2%。数据规模方面，benchmark 含 319 个 paired triplets，来源于 nuScenes 和 DROID 两个真实 embodied 场景数据源。就诊断价值而言，这些数字已经足够说明：现有模型在单样本 realism 上的进步，并没有自动转化为可用于控制和规划的差分物理建模能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，作者对 failure mode 的定义很清楚，能迅速理解为什么单视频 benchmark 不够。然后看 benchmark construction，重点是六类 intervention primitive 的定义标准，以及 prompt pair 如何保证只改一个变量。接着看 APEO 评测协议，尤其是 Adherence / Physics / Environment / Outcome 四项如何区分不同错误来源。最后看主结果表和按 primitive 分解的结果，那里最能体现 contrastive bottleneck。若只花 25 分钟，建议看图示样例、taxonomy、APEO 定义和主表；若要判断它是否能指导训练目标设计，再细读 human validation 和 failure case 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode that current video world-model benchmarks mostly miss: whether the model’s output changes appropriately when a controlled physical variable in the input changes. Existing benchmarks score videos one by one and ask whether each sample looks plausible in isolation. That misses the more consequential error: two prompts differ in exactly one physical condition, yet the model produces nearly the same video for both. For driving, robotics, model-based planning, and policy training, this is more damaging than imperfect realism, because it means the model is not controllably responsive to interventions.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining and world-model research is fairly direct. The paper shifts the evaluation target from visual realism to causal sensitivity, especially differential response to interventions. That has implications for training objectives, data construction, and evaluation protocols for video generation and action-conditioned world models. If training only rewards single-sample realism, models may learn visual templates rather than dynamics that are useful for planning. The contribution is moderate but solid: no new architecture, but a benchmark that isolates a capability current evaluation largely ignores, and empirical evidence that many strong models remain weak on it.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts: benchmark construction and paired evaluation. First, What-If World builds a contrastive benchmark around physically meaningful interventions. Two domain experts define and merge intervention variables into six primitives spanning autonomous driving and robotic manipulation. Environment-side primitives include surface friction, material/medium, and obstacle configuration. Agent-side primitives include spatial alignment, force/degree, and temporal sequencing. Each test case is a paired triplet: the same initial frame x0 plus two prompts that differ in exactly one semantic variable. Construction proceeds in three steps: filter suitable clips from nuScenes or DROID; extract the frame right before the action starts and pair it with shared scene descriptors; then author a prompt pair that changes only the intervention variable. The goal is to approximate ceteris paribus through prompt design so that output differences can be attributed to the intervention. Second, the APEO evaluation framework decomposes success into four criteria: Adherence, whether the intervention was executed; Physics, whether the dynamics are valid; Environment, whether the non-intervened scene stays stable; and Outcome, whether the paired outputs diverge as the intervention predicts. The first three are scored in both single-video and paired modes, while Outcome is inherently paired-only. This decomposition is useful because it separates different failure modes: the intervention may be ignored, executed without sufficient divergence, or confounded by scene drift. The implementation uses a VLM judge validated against human annotation.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is applied to nine state-of-the-art video generation world models, including four open-source and five closed-source systems. Three results stand out. First, no model exceeds 52% on the paired metric, and the four open-source models cluster around 28%, indicating that causal sensitivity is still weak. Second, there is a substantial gap between single-video scores and paired scores, which the authors call the contrastive bottleneck: models can generate two individually convincing videos while still failing to differentiate them in the way the input requires. Third, performance appears to track the visual salience of the intervention’s consequences more than robust physical understanding. Force/Degree, which often causes large visible motion changes, reaches 40.4%, while Surface Friction, which induces subtler trajectory differences, drops to 14.2%. The benchmark itself contains 319 paired triplets built from real embodied data sources, nuScenes and DROID. As a diagnostic result, these numbers are already enough to show that better single-sample realism does not automatically translate into controllable physical simulation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction. The failure mode is stated very clearly, and it immediately explains why per-video benchmarks are insufficient. Then read the benchmark construction section, focusing on how the six intervention primitives are defined and how prompt pairs are constrained to differ in only one variable. After that, read the APEO protocol, especially how Adherence, Physics, Environment, and Outcome disentangle different error sources. Finally, inspect the main result table and the per-primitive breakdown; that is where the contrastive bottleneck becomes most visible. If you only have 25 minutes, prioritize the motivating examples, the primitive taxonomy, the APEO definition, and the main quantitative table. Read the human-validation and failure-case sections only if you want to judge whether this benchmark can inform future training objectives.

recommendation.zh: 非常好的 World Model 评测视角，从单样本的 'plausibility' 转向对比样本的 'causality'，对于做多模态/视频生成的 pretrain 团队来说，这是衡量模型是否真正学到物理规律的关键 metric。
recommendation.en: An excellent evaluation perspective for World Models, shifting from single-sample 'plausibility' to contrastive 'causality'. Crucial metric for multimodal/video pretrain teams to measure if models actually learn physical laws.

paper.title: E$^3$C: Video Generation with 3D Environmental Memory and Ego-Exo Human Pose Control
paper.abstract: Controllable and physically grounded egocentric video generation is essential for embodied agents to reason about how their own and others' actions manifest and change the world. Compared to generic video synthesis, egocentric generation is especially challenging: the camera is tightly coupled to the actor, leading to rapid viewpoint changes and frequent self-occlusions; the underlying actions are subtle, articulated, and often only partially visible; and both the people and the scene state must

summary.core_problem: 解决第一视角视频生成中相机运动、人体动作、遮挡和场景状态需要长期一致控制的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成方法创新，面向 embodied agents 的可控世界模拟。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对多模态世界模型、视频 token/latent 条件设计和具身数据生成有旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: E3C 使用视频扩散框架，把持久场景结构和人体驱动动态分开建模：从上下文帧构建半稠密点云形式的 3D environmental memory，并用 video-VAE 特征为点云附加外观描述；随后将该记忆渲染到目标视角，作为与目标帧对齐的条件，同时引入 ego-exo human pose control 来约束自我动作和他人动作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度；实验应围绕 egocentric controllable video generation 的时空一致性、控制遵循度和视觉质量展开。
summary.authors_note: Richard Newcombe 和 Julian Straub 是 Meta Reality Labs 相关的知名 3D/场景理解研究者；团队背景更偏 3D 感知、AR/VR 和具身视觉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses controllable egocentric video generation, where camera motion, human pose, occlusion, and persistent scene state must remain consistent.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation method rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its relevance is indirect: the conditioning design is useful for thinking about multimodal world models and structured latent memory for embodied data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: E3C builds a structured conditioning interface for a video diffusion model. It extracts a semi-dense point-cloud 3D environmental memory from context frames, augments points with appearance descriptors from video-VAE features, renders the memory into target views, and combines it with ego-exo human pose control to separate persistent scene structure from action-driven dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, training scale, baseline list, or numerical improvements. The likely evaluation focuses on egocentric generation quality, temporal consistency, and controllability under pose and viewpoint changes.
summary_en.authors_note: Richard Newcombe and Julian Straub are known for 3D vision and AR/VR work at Meta Reality Labs; the team is closer to embodied vision and scene reconstruction than to language-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 3D memory 条件设计即可；对统一视频 LM 不是直接答案，但能提醒别把场景状态全塞进隐变量。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and the 3D-memory conditioning; it is not a direct recipe for video LMs, but it is a useful reminder not to hide all scene state in latents.

paper.title: SceneCode: Executable World Programs for Editable Indoor Scenes with Articulated Objects
paper.abstract: Indoor scene synthesis underpins embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy evaluation, where a useful scene must specify not only what the environment looks like, but also how its objects are structured. Existing pipelines, however, typically represent generated content as static meshes and inherit articulation only from curated asset libraries, which limits object-level controllability and prevents new interactable assets from being produced on demand. We address this gap b

summary.core_problem: 解决室内场景生成中静态 mesh 难以表达可交互、可编辑、带关节物体的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 3D/embodied 场景生成的表示与系统创新。SceneCode 把自然语言到室内世界的生成目标从 opaque meshes 转为 executable world programs，使场景可以包含结构化布局、对象级控制和 articulation。对多模态生成和具身仿真有意义，但离 LLM 基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 框架先用 room-level agentic backbone 将自然语言 prompt 转成结构化 house layout，并通过 planner-designer-critic loop 生成每个物体的 AssetRequest。随后根据请求路由到五类代码生成策略，把对象转换为可执行、可编辑的程序化资产，而不是只生成静态几何网格。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出数据集规模、评测模型、用户评测或物理交互指标的具体数字。应重点检查其生成资产的物理有效性、关节参数正确性、编辑稳定性，以及与 mesh-based 或 asset-library-based pipeline 的对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港中文大学、上海交通大学、上海人工智能实验室和牛津大学；Linjie Li、Zhengyuan Yang、Yu Cheng 等作者在多模态与视觉语言模型方向有较多代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation of indoor scene generation pipelines that produce static meshes and cannot reliably represent editable, interactable, articulated objects.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a representation and system design for 3D and embodied scene generation. SceneCode reframes indoor-world generation from opaque meshes to executable world programs, enabling structured layouts, object-level control, and articulation. This is useful for multimodal generation and simulation, but only weakly connected to base LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework uses a room-level agentic backbone to convert a natural-language prompt into a structured house layout, then emits per-object AssetRequests through a planner-designer-critic loop. Each request is routed to one of five code-generation strategies, producing executable and editable programmatic assets rather than static geometry alone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, evaluated models, user-study results, or physical-interaction metrics. The key evidence to inspect is whether generated assets are physically valid, whether articulation parameters are correct, whether edits are stable, and how the system compares with mesh-based or asset-library-based pipelines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, and the University of Oxford. Linjie Li, Zhengyuan Yang, and Yu Cheng have substantial prior work in multimodal and vision-language modeling.

recommendation.zh: 作为“程序化世界表示”备查即可；它对 world model 表示有趣，但不是预训练方法论文。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for programmatic world representations; interesting for world-model interfaces, but not a pretraining-method paper.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence unfolds through a perception-action loop: agents act to acquire observations, and reason about how observations vary as a function of action. Rather than passively processing what is seen, they actively uncover what is unseen - occluded structure, dynamics, containment, and functionality that cannot be resolved from passive sensing alone. We move beyond prior formulations of spatial intelligence that assume oracle observations by recasting the observer as an actor. We introd

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评估 embodied spatial intelligence 的 benchmark，让模型通过行动主动获取观察，而不是只在给定观察上做被动空间推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。ESI-Bench 把空间智能评测从静态感知推进到 perception-action loop，覆盖遮挡结构、动态、容器关系和功能性等需要主动探索的信息，对多模态 agent 评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 OmniGibson 构建 10 个任务类别和 29 个子类别，并以 Spelke 的 core knowledge systems 组织任务。Agent 需要选择 perception、locomotion、manipulation 等能力，并规划动作序列来积累与任务相关的证据。
summary.experiments: 论文评测多种主流 MLLM。摘要报告 active exploration 明显优于 passive counterparts，说明当前模型在主动获取信息时可获得更好的空间推理表现，但具体模型列表和提升幅度需看正文实验表。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Leonidas Guibas、Li Fei-Fei、Jiajun Wu、Yejin Choi，相关团队长期从事 3D 视觉、具身智能、多模态推理和 AI 评测研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates embodied spatial intelligence where agents must act to acquire observations, rather than reason passively over oracle observations.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. ESI-Bench moves spatial intelligence evaluation toward a perception-action loop, covering occlusion, dynamics, containment, and functionality that cannot be resolved from passive sensing alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is built on OmniGibson with 10 task categories and 29 subcategories, organized around Spelke’s core knowledge systems. Agents must choose and sequence perception, locomotion, and manipulation skills to gather task-relevant evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates current MLLMs. The abstract reports that active exploration substantially outperforms passive counterparts, though the exact model list and numerical gains require the main experimental tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Leonidas Guibas, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, and Yejin Choi, whose groups are known for 3D vision, embodied AI, multimodal reasoning, and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 看任务 taxonomy 和 passive-vs-active 对照；它更像下一代 VLM/agent eval 资产，不是训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the task taxonomy and passive-vs-active comparison; this is a next-wave VLM/agent eval asset, not a training recipe.

paper.title: EgoExo-WM: Unlocking Exo Video for Ego World Models
paper.abstract: Egocentric world models present a promising direction for enabling agents to predict and plan, but their performance is constrained by the limited availability of egocentric training data and its inherent partial observability of humans' physical actions. In contrast, exocentric video is abundant and reveals body poses well, but lacks direct alignment with an agent's action space -- and is not egocentric. We propose a method to bridge this gap by extracting structured body pose from exocentric v

summary.core_problem: 第一人称世界模型的训练受限于第一人称数据规模小、动作空间所需的3D人体姿态标注难以获取的瓶颈，而海量第三人称视频因视角不匹配、缺乏与智能体动作空间的对齐，无法直接用于第一人称世界模型训练。
summary.importance: 为第一人称世界模型的训练数据扩展提供了可落地的低成本路径，证明可通过第三人称视频转换补充训练数据，缓解通用具身模型的数据瓶颈，对具身多模态预训练的数据工程有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: EgoExo-WM框架以3D人体运动为统一表示，桥接第三人称与第一人称视角。首先从第三人称视频中提取3D人体运动作为动作空间的标注，再基于带人体运动学先验的视角转换模块，将第三人称视频转换为与提取的动作序列对齐的第一人称视频。转换得到的成对（第一人称视频+3D动作）数据与原生第一人称数据混合，用于训练基于视觉隐空间的动作条件第一人称世界模型。该世界模型使用预训练的DINOv3-L编码器提取视觉隐特征，输入历史窗口的过往隐特征和下一步3D动作，预测下一帧的视觉隐状态。框架还支持通过排序动作序列进行规划，找到能到达目标视觉状态的动作路径。
summary.experiments: 在Home Action Genome、LEMMA、Ego-Exo4D三个第一人称数据集上评测，未来帧预测表现优于现有第一人称世界模型基线；下游规划任务中，可有效生成达到目标视觉状态的3D人体运动序列。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的动机和第3章的视角转换模块设计，实验部分查看主结果表即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。核心关注如何用统一的动作表示实现跨视角数据对齐，不需要深挖世界模型的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Egocentric world model training is bottlenecked by small scales of available egocentric datasets and the difficulty of obtaining 3D human pose annotations required for the action space. Abundant exocentric (third-person) videos cannot be directly used for egocentric world model training due to viewpoint mismatch and lack of alignment with the agent's action space.
summary_en.importance: This framework provides a practical, low-cost path to expand training data for egocentric world models, proving that exocentric video conversion can supplement training data to alleviate the data bottleneck of general embodied models. It has direct reference value for data engineering in embodied multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EgoExo-WM uses 3D human motion as a unified representation to bridge exocentric and egocentric viewpoints. First, 3D human motion is extracted from exocentric videos as annotations for the action space. Then a viewpoint conversion module with human kinematics priors transforms exocentric videos into egocentric videos aligned with the extracted motion sequences. The converted paired (egocentric video + 3D action) data is mixed with native egocentric data to train an action-conditioned egocentric world model operating in visual latent space. The world model uses a pretrained DINOv3-L encoder to extract visual latents, and predicts the next frame's latent state given a history window of past latents and the next 3D action. The framework also supports planning by ranking action sequences to find the path that leads to a target visual state.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three egocentric datasets: Home Action Genome, LEMMA, and Ego-Exo4D. EgoExo-WM outperforms existing egocentric world model baselines on future frame prediction. On downstream planning tasks, it can effectively generate 3D human motion sequences that reach the target visual state.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, read Section 1 for motivation and Section 3 for the viewpoint conversion module design. Review the main results table in experiments. Expected reading time is 15 minutes. Focus on how unified action representation enables cross-view data alignment; no need to dive deep into world model implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据转换 pipeline；它把“外部视角数据不可用于 ego world model”的先验打松了。
recommendation.en: Read the data-conversion pipeline; it weakens the prior that exocentric video is unusable for ego world-model training.

paper.title: UAM: A Dual-Stream Perspective on Forgetting in VLA Training
paper.abstract: Vision--language--action (VLA) models are typically built by fine-tuning a pretrained vision--language model (VLM) on action data. However, we show that this standard recipe systematically erodes the VLM's multimodal competence, a side effect we call the embodiment tax. But do VLAs have to forget? Inspired by the two-stream organization of biological vision, we trace this degradation to a structural bottleneck: current VLAs ask a single encoder to support both language-grounded semantics and con

summary.core_problem: VLA模型基于预训练VLM做动作任务微调时，会不可逆丢失原VLM的通用多模态语义能力，该现象被称为具身税。现有冻结VLM参数、引入辅助多模态数据协同训练的方案仅能缓解症状，未解决底层结构冲突问题。
summary.importance: 为多模态持续预训练、跨任务能力保留的架构设计提供了神经科学启发的新思路，验证了功能模块化分离对缓解灾难性遗忘的作用，可迁移到多模态LLM基座预训练的多任务能力保留场景。
summary.technical_approach: 参考灵长类视觉皮层双通路结构，在原有负责语义理解的VLM（对应腹侧通路）之外，新增并行的背侧专家模块（对应视觉运动控制通路），通过混合Transformer层耦合两个通路与动作头。端到端训练时无需冻结参数、无需额外多模态辅助数据，两个通路分别提取语义特征和控制相关视觉特征，避免表示冲突。
summary.experiments: 仅在动作数据上微调时，UAM在多模态基准上的平均能力损失低于5%，保留原VLM 95%以上的语义能力；在分布外真实机器人场景（未知物体、新目标组合、指令变体等）上的表现优于所有对比方案。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读3.1节的遗忘度量方法、3.3节的背侧专家初始化对比实验、4.3节的通路特征可视化分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models fine-tuned from pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffer from irreversible loss of general multimodal semantic capabilities during action task adaptation, which is defined as the embodiment tax. Existing remedies including VLM parameter freezing and auxiliary multimodal data co-training only alleviate symptoms instead of addressing the underlying structural conflict.
summary_en.importance: It provides a neuroscience-inspired architectural design paradigm for multimodal continual pretraining and cross-task capability retention, verifying that functional modular separation effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting. The design can be transferred to multi-task capability preservation scenarios in multimodal LLM base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Drawing on the dual-stream structure of primate visual cortex, a parallel Dorsal Expert module (corresponding to the visuomotor control pathway) is added on top of the original semantic VLM (corresponding to the ventral recognition pathway). The two streams and the action head are coupled via mixture-of-transformer layers. No parameter freezing or extra multimodal auxiliary data is required during end-to-end training, as the two streams separately extract semantic features and control-related visual features to avoid representational conflict.
summary_en.experiments: When fine-tuned only on action data, UAM incurs less than 5% average capability degradation on multimodal benchmarks, retaining over 95% of the original VLM's semantic competence. It outperforms all compared variants on out-of-distribution real-world robot scenarios, including unseen objects, novel object-target compositions and instruction variations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3.1 for the forgetting measurement metric, Section 3.3 for comparative experiments on Dorsal Expert initialization, and Section 4.3 for pathway feature visualization analysis. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 VLA 训练中的“具身税”现象，并用双流架构解耦语义与控制特征，对多模态统一建模（特别是引入 action 模态）有架构设计上的启发，建议看 §3 架构设计。
recommendation.en: Reveals the 'embodiment tax' in VLA training and uses a dual-stream architecture to decouple semantic and control features. Offers architectural insights for unified multimodal modeling (especially incorporating action modalities). Read §3 for architecture design.

paper.title: PhysBrain 1.0 Technical Report
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action models have advanced rapidly, but robot trajectories alone provide limited coverage for learning broad physical understanding. PhysBrain 1.0 studies a complementary route: converting large-scale human egocentric video into structured physical commonsense supervision before robot adaptation. Our data engine extracts scene elements, spatial dynamics, action execution, and depth-aware relations, then turns them into question-answer supervision for training PhysBrain VLMs. The

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言动作（VLA）模型仅用机器人轨迹训练，物理常识覆盖不足，域外化性能差
summary.importance: 方法创新+数据贡献，提出将人类第一视角视频转化为物理常识QA监督的流水线，实现机器人控制的跨域性能提升
summary.technical_approach: 构建数据引擎从egocentric视频提取场景元素、空间动态、动作执行、深度关系，转化为QA对训练VLM，再通过能力保留的适配方法迁移到VLA策略
summary.experiments: 在多模态QA和具身控制基准上取得最优结果，SimplerEnv上域外性能提升尤为显著
summary.authors_note: 作者团队包含清华大学知名AI学者胡晓林

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models are only trained on robot trajectories, lack sufficient physical common sense coverage, and have poor out-of-domain performance
summary_en.importance: Methodological + data contribution, proposes pipeline to convert human egocentric videos into physical common sense QA supervision, improves cross-domain performance of robot control
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds data engine to extract scene elements, spatial dynamics, action execution, depth-aware relations from egocentric videos, converts to QA pairs for VLM training, then transfers to VLA policies via capability-preserving adaptation
summary_en.experiments: Achieves SOTA on multimodal QA and embodied control benchmarks, especially significant out-of-domain performance improvement on SimplerEnv
summary_en.authors_note: Team includes well-known AI researcher Xiaolin Hu from Tsinghua University

paper.title: Pelican-Unified 1.0: A Unified Embodied Intelligence Model for Understanding, Reasoning, Imagination and Action
paper.abstract: We present Pelican-Unified 1.0, the first embodied foundation model trained according to the principle of unification. Pelican-Unified 1.0 uses a single VLM as a unified understanding module, mapping scenes, instructions, visual contexts, and action histories into a shared semantic space. The same VLM also serves as a unified reasoning module, autoregressively producing task-, action-, and future-oriented chains of thought in a single forward pass and projecting the final hidden state into a den

summary.core_problem: 现有具身智能模型多采用独立模块拼接的流水线架构，感知、推理、世界建模、动作策略四部分相互割裂，存在语义断层、泛化性差、长时序任务误差累积等问题。
summary.importance: 提出具身智能的统一建模范式，为多模态预训练向具身场景扩展提供架构设计参考，验证了共享表示联合优化的可行性，不需要在各专项能力上做性能妥协。
summary.technical_approach: 采用单VLM作为共享的理解与推理模块，将场景、指令、视觉上下文、动作历史映射到统一语义空间，自回归生成面向任务、动作、未来的思维链并输出隐变量；后续接统一未来生成器（UFG），基于该隐变量在同一扩散去噪过程中用两个模态头同时生成未来视频和底层动作；训练时语言、视频、动作损失同时回传到共享表示层，实现四类能力联合优化。
summary.experiments: 单checkpoint在三类任务上表现突出：8个VLM基准得分64.7，同等参规模型中最优；WorldArena基准得分66.03，排名第一；RoboTwin动作基准得分93.5，对比方法中平均排名第二。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节统一范式的定义、第3节模型架构设计、第4节核心实验结果，跳过相关工作和冗余实验细节部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing embodied intelligence models adopt a pipeline architecture stitched with independent modules, leading to fragmentation across perception, reasoning, world modeling and action policy, which causes semantic gaps, poor generalization, and error accumulation in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a unified modeling paradigm for embodied intelligence, provides architecture design references for extending multimodal pretraining to embodied scenarios, and verifies that joint optimization of shared representations requires no performance tradeoff across individual specialized capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single VLM serves as the shared understanding and reasoning module, which maps scenes, instructions, visual contexts and action histories into a unified semantic space, autoregressively generates task-, action- and future-oriented chains of thought, and outputs the corresponding latent variable. A Unified Future Generator (UFG) conditions on this latent variable, and generates both future videos and low-level actions via two modality-specific heads within the same diffusion denoising process. During training, language, video and action losses are all backpropagated to the shared representation layer to enable joint optimization of four capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: A single checkpoint achieves strong performance across three task categories: 64.7 on 8 VLM benchmarks, best among models with comparable parameter scale; 66.03 on WorldArena, ranking first; 93.5 on RoboTwin action benchmark, second average rank among compared methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the definition of unified paradigm, Section 3 for model architecture design, Section 4 for core experiment results. Skip related work and redundant experiment details. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 具身智能统一建模的尝试——用单一VLM+扩散生成器连接推理、视频预测和动作生成。共享表示学习的思路对多模态预训练有一定参考。只看方法架构部分即可。
recommendation.en: An attempt at unified embodied intelligence — a single VLM + diffusion generator connecting reasoning, video prediction, and action generation. The shared representation approach has some reference value for multimodal pretraining. Just read the architecture section.

paper.title: CreFlow: Corrective Reflow for Sparse-Reward Embodied Video Diffusion RL
paper.abstract: Video generation models trained on heterogeneous data with likelihood-surrogate objectives can produce visually plausible rollouts that violate physical constraints in embodied manipulation. Although reinforcement-learning post-training offers a natural route to adapting VGMs, existing video-RL rewards often reduce each rollout to a low-level visual metric, whereas manipulation video evaluation requires logic-based verification of whether the rollout satisfies a compositional task specification.

paper.title: How Far Are VLMs from Privacy Awareness in the Physical World? An Empirical Study
paper.abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous cognitive cores for embodied assistants, evaluating their privacy awareness in physical environments becomes critical. Unlike digital chatbots, these agents operate in intimate spaces, such as homes and hospitals, where they possess the physical agency to observe and manipulate privacy-sensitive information and artifacts. However, current benchmarks remain limited to unimodal, text-based representations that cannot capture

summary.core_problem: 评估 VLM 在真实物理环境中是否具备隐私意识，包括识别敏感物品、理解社交语境变化，以及在用户命令和隐私约束冲突时做出合适判断。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态/具身 VLM 的隐私评测框架。它不是模型预训练方法，但能暴露当前 VLM 在物理世界部署中的安全与对齐缺口，尤其是从纯文本隐私评测扩展到音视频交互场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ImmersedPrivacy，一个基于 Unity 的交互式音视频评测环境。评测分为三个递进层级：在杂乱场景中识别敏感物品，随社交上下文变化调整隐私判断，以及处理显式指令与隐含隐私约束之间的冲突。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出被测 VLM 名单、场景数量、任务样本量或具体准确率。可确认实验对象是多模态模型在模拟物理环境中的交互式隐私意识，而非静态图文问答。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Georgia Institute of Technology；从给定信息无法确认是否有大模型预训练代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether VLMs have privacy awareness in physical environments, including sensitive-object recognition, social-context adaptation, and resolving conflicts between explicit commands and inferred privacy constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a privacy benchmark for multimodal and embodied VLMs. It is not a pretraining method, but it exposes safety and alignment gaps for physical-world deployment, moving beyond text-only privacy evaluation into audiovisual interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces ImmersedPrivacy, an interactive audiovisual evaluation framework built with a Unity simulator. The benchmark has three progressive tiers: identifying sensitive items in cluttered scenes, adapting to changing social context, and handling conflicts between direct instructions and implicit privacy constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list evaluated VLMs, scene counts, task volume, or quantitative accuracy. The confirmed setup is interactive privacy evaluation in simulated physical environments rather than static image-text QA.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Georgia Institute of Technology; the provided metadata does not establish a specific foundation-model pretraining track record.

recommendation.zh: VLM 预训练研究只需扫 benchmark 设计；它测的是部署语境缺口，不太会给训练目标带来直接新信号。
recommendation.en: For VLM pretraining, skim the benchmark design only; it measures deployment-context gaps rather than giving a direct new training signal.

paper.title: Embody4D: A Generalist 4D World Model for Embodied AI
paper.abstract: World models have made significant progress in modeling dynamic environments; however, most embodied world models are still restricted to 2D representations, lacking the comprehensive multi-view information essential for embodied spatial reasoning. Bridging this gap is non-trivial, primarily due to challenges from severe scarcity of paired multi-view data, the difficulty of maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in generated 3D geometries, and the tendency to hallucinate manipulation details. To

summary.core_problem: 解决具身AI世界模型只建模2D动态画面、缺少多视角4D空间一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成世界模型和数据合成管线；对预训练研究的间接价值在于如何用合成数据和几何约束补齐稀缺的多视角交互数据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Embody4D，一个面向具身场景的视频到视频世界模型，可从单目视频合成任意新视角。方法包括3D-aware compositional synthesis，用不同机械臂和背景组合构造异构数据；再用adaptive noise injection约束时空几何稳定，减少操作细节幻觉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline和具体指标；声称能在跨具身形态的机器人场景中提升泛化，并保持生成3D几何的时空一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、中国科学技术大学、中国科学院自动化所、北京航空航天大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of multi-view 4D spatial consistency in embodied world models that mostly operate in 2D video space.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative embodied world model and synthetic data pipeline. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is how synthetic composition and geometric constraints are used when paired multi-view interaction data is scarce.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embody4D is a video-to-video world model that synthesizes arbitrary novel views from a monocular video. It uses a 3D-aware compositional synthesis pipeline to combine robotic arms and backgrounds, and an adaptive noise injection strategy to improve spatiotemporal geometry stability and reduce manipulation hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved cross-embodiment generalization and more stable 3D geometry in generated embodied scenes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Automation CAS, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 只扫数据合成和noise injection即可；它不是LLM预训练，但多视角稀缺数据的处理方式可作多模态预训练备忘。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and noise-injection parts only; not LLM pretraining, but useful as a note on scarce multi-view data.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
Institute of automation, Chinese academy of science

paper.title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
paper.abstract: Visual-Language-Action models (VLAs) have advanced generalist robot control by mapping multimodal observations and language instructions directly to actions, but sparse action supervision often encourages shortcut mappings rather than representations of dynamics, contact, and task progress. Recent world-action models introduce future prediction through video rollouts, yet pixel-space prediction is a costly and indirect substrate for control, as it may model visual details irrelevant to action ge

summary.core_problem: 在机器人 VLA 策略中引入未来感知的世界模型能力，同时避免像素级视频 rollout 带来的训练和推理开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是具身多模态策略中的方法创新：把未来预测从显式视频生成转为隐变量接口，对 latent reasoning 和 action-conditioned representation 有一定参考价值，但仍主要服务机器人控制。
summary.technical_approach: Being-H0.7 在感知模块和动作头之间插入可学习 latent queries，作为紧凑的推理接口。训练时使用双分支设计：部署时可用的 prior branch 只从当前上下文推断 latent state；训练期 posterior branch 引入未来信息，为 latent 表示提供监督或对齐信号，从而让策略获得未来感知但不生成未来帧。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露参数量、训练数据规模、机器人基准、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的是论文定位为 VLA/world-action model，对比对象应包括直接 VLA 策略和像素空间未来预测式 world-action model。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to add future-aware world-modeling capability to VLA-style robot policies without paying the cost of pixel-space video rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a method-level change for embodied multimodal policies: replacing explicit future-frame generation with a latent reasoning interface. This is relevant to latent reasoning and action-conditioned representation learning, but remains mainly a robotics-control paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Being-H0.7 inserts learnable latent queries between perception and action as a compact reasoning bottleneck. It uses a dual-branch training scheme: a deployable prior branch infers latent states from the current context, while a training-only posterior branch uses future information to shape or align the latent representation, enabling future-aware control without generating future frames.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, training-data scale, benchmark names, baseline details, or numerical gains. The intended comparisons are direct VLA policies and pixel-space future-prediction world-action models.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和双分支训练细节；latent future supervision 的思路可借鉴，机器人实验本身不用深读。
recommendation.en: Read only the method diagram and dual-branch training details; the latent future supervision idea transfers, the robotics results less so.

paper.title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
paper.abstract: World models, which are predictive representations of how environments evolve under actions, have become a central component of robot learning. They support policy learning, planning, simulation, evaluation, data generation, and have advanced rapidly with the rise of foundation models and large-scale video generation. However, the literature remains fragmented across architectures, functional roles, and embodied application domains. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive review of world

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理机器人学习中的 world model：环境如何在动作作用下演化，以及这些预测表征如何服务策略学习、规划、仿真、评估和数据生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和知识组织。它把机器人 world model、视频生成式世界模型、导航和自动驾驶中的相关工作放在一个框架里，对关注 embodied foundation model 的研究员有背景价值，但不是新的训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从机器人学习视角分类 world model：讨论 world model 与策略的耦合方式、作为 learned simulator 支持 RL 和评估的角色、机器人视频 world model 从 imagination-based generation 到可控、结构化和 foundation-scale formulation 的演进，并整理数据集、benchmark 和评测协议。
summary.experiments: 作为综述论文，没有新模型训练或统一实验结果。主要产出是文献分类、功能角色分析、代表性数据集和 benchmark 总结。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自南洋理工大学、UC Berkeley、Stanford、Microsoft 等机构；作者列表包括 Tatsuya Harada 和 Philip Torr 等知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes world models for robot learning: predictive representations of environment dynamics under actions and their use in policy learning, planning, simulation, evaluation, and data generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey and taxonomy contribution. It connects robot world models, video-generation-based world models, navigation, and autonomous driving under a shared framing. It is useful background for embodied foundation models but not a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reviews how world models are coupled with robot policies, how they act as learned simulators for reinforcement learning and evaluation, and how robotic video world models evolved from imagination-based generation to controllable, structured, and foundation-scale formulations. It also summarizes datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not train a new model or report unified empirical results. Its main output is a taxonomy, role analysis, and a catalog of representative datasets and benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes researchers from Nanyang Technological University, UC Berkeley, Stanford, and Microsoft, with well-known senior researchers such as Tatsuya Harada and Philip Torr.

recommendation.zh: 作为 embodied world model 索引可留存；预训练研究员读 taxonomy 和 benchmark 表即可，不必逐节精读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an embodied world-model index; for pretraining work, the taxonomy and benchmark tables are enough.

paper.title: SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced static visual--spatial reasoning, yet they often fail to preserve long-horizon spatial coherence in embodied settings where beliefs must be continuously revised from egocentric observations under environmental change. We introduce SpaMEM (Spatial Memory from Action Sequences), a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that isolates the mechanics of spatial belief evolution via action-conditioned scene transformations (spawn, place, remove) over lon

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型在动态具身环境下长时序空间推理能力差，缺乏针对性诊断基准
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次提出针对具身场景动态空间信念演化的大规模诊断基准，填补了静态空间推理到动态具身空间推理评测的空白
summary.technical_approach: 构建SpaMEM基准，包含1000个程序化生成的房屋的25000+交互序列，覆盖4种模态数据，将具身空间推理分为3层级15个诊断任务
summary.experiments: 数据集包含10,601,392张高保真图像，覆盖RGB、深度、实例分割、语义分割4模态，通过3层级任务测试MLLM的原子感知、时序推理、动态空间记忆能力
summary.authors_note: 机构包括阿拉巴马大学、复旦大学、浙江大学、新疆大学，无已知LLM领域知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal large language models perform poorly on long-horizon dynamic spatial reasoning in embodied environments, and there is a lack of targeted diagnostic benchmarks for this capability
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, the first large-scale diagnostic benchmark focused on dynamic spatial belief evolution in embodied scenarios, filling the gap between static spatial reasoning evaluation and embodied dynamic spatial reasoning evaluation
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs SpaMEM benchmark with 25,000+ interaction sequences across 1,000 procedurally generated houses, covering four modalities, and divides embodied spatial reasoning into three hierarchical levels with 15 diagnostic tasks
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 10,601,392 high-fidelity images of four modalities (RGB, depth, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation), with three levels of tasks to test atomic perception, temporal reasoning, and dynamic spatial memory capabilities of MLLMs
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include University of Alabama, Fudan University, Zhejiang University, Xinjiang University, no well-known authors in LLM field identified

recommendation.zh: 针对MLLM具身空间能力的评测基准，仅作为多模态评测方向的文献备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: This is a benchmark for MLLM embodied spatial reasoning capability, only for literature reference in multimodal evaluation, no need to read full text

paper.title: EmbodiedMidtrain: Bridging the Gap between Vision-Language Models and Vision-Language-Action Models via Mid-training
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) inherit their visual and linguistic capabilities from Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet most VLAs are built from off-the-shelf VLMs that are not adapted to the embodied domain, limiting their downstream performance. In this work, we propose EmbodiedMidtrain to bridge the gap between VLMs and VLAs. We first characterize the data distribution gap between them, showing that VLA data occupy compact regions that are largely separated from the broader VLM distribu

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）大多采用通用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）作为骨干网络，VLM预训练数据分布和VLA所用的机器人交互轨迹数据分布存在显著差异，直接微调VLM无法有效适配具身场景，限制了VLA的下游性能。
summary.importance: 验证了中期训练（mid-training）在跨领域模型初始化中的价值，提出的数据选择方法可以较低成本提升VLA的初始适配性，对多模态预训练到下游垂直领域适配的流程优化有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出EmbodiedMidtrain框架，首先训练一个轻量 proximity 估计器，在冻结的VLM特征上做二分类区分VLA和VLM数据，输出的分数作为每个VLM样本与VLA域的对齐度；从大规模VLM数据池中选出对齐度最高的样本组成中期训练数据集，用该数据集对VLM做中期训练后，再作为VLA微调的初始化。该方法不需要修改VLM或VLA的架构，可扩展性强。
summary.experiments: 在Calvin ABC-D、SimplerEnv Bridge、Libero-10三个具身机器人基准上测试，1.1B参数的中期训练后模型获得显著性能提升；筛选出的数据集可跨架构迁移，用InternVL3.5-1B选出的数据集在Qwen3VL-2B上也能获得一致提升；学习得到的proximity估计器效果优于人工设计的特征空间距离、困惑度等指标；中期训练的优势从微调初期就存在，且随训练进程差距逐渐扩大，说明其提供了更优的初始化而非临时领先。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注数据分布差异分析、proximity估计器设计和跨架构迁移实验部分，预计阅读时间25分钟，无需深挖机器人任务的具体评测细节，优先关注中期训练的数据选择逻辑和效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models use off-the-shelf general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones, which have a significant distribution gap between VLM pretraining data and VLA robotic interaction trajectory data. Direct fine-tuning of VLMs cannot effectively adapt to embodied scenarios, limiting downstream VLA performance.
summary_en.importance: It validates the value of mid-training for cross-domain model initialization. The proposed data selection method improves VLA initialization adaptability at low cost, which provides reference for optimizing the pipeline from multimodal pretraining to vertical domain adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The EmbodiedMidtrain framework is proposed. First, a lightweight proximity estimator is trained to classify VLA and VLM data on frozen VLM features, and the output score is used as the alignment degree between each VLM sample and the VLA domain. The highest-aligned samples are selected from a large VLM pool to form a mid-training dataset, which is used to mid-train the VLM before VLA fine-tuning. No architectural changes to VLMs or VLAs are required, and the pipeline is scalable.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on three embodied robot benchmarks: Calvin ABC-D, SimplerEnv Bridge, and Libero-10. The 1.1B parameter mid-trained model achieves significant performance gains. The curated dataset transfers across architectures: the mixture selected with InternVL3.5-1B also brings consistent gains on Qwen3VL-2B. The learned proximity estimator outperforms hand-crafted metrics like feature space distance and perplexity. The advantage of mid-training emerges from the earliest fine-tuning steps and widens over time, indicating it provides a fundamentally better initialization rather than a transient head start.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the data distribution gap analysis, proximity estimator design, and cross-architecture transfer experiments. Estimated reading time is 25 minutes. No need to dive into specific evaluation details of robotic tasks, prioritize the data selection logic and effect of mid-training.

recommendation.zh: 将 mid-training 概念引入具身 VLA 领域，其数据筛选引擎（proximity estimator）的设计对跨域数据混合有一定参考价值，建议关注其数据分布差异的量化分析部分。
recommendation.en: Introduces mid-training to embodied VLAs; the design of the proximity estimator for data filtering offers insights for cross-domain data mixing. The quantitative analysis of distribution gaps is worth skimming.

institutions: Language Technologies Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
Bosch Research North America & Bosch Center for Artificial Intelligence (BCAI)

paper.title: HiVLA: A Visual-Grounded-Centric Hierarchical Embodied Manipulation System

summary.core_problem: 端到端VLA在机器人操控微调后容易牺牲基座VLM的高层推理能力，如何在保持语义推理的同时获得稳定可控的低层动作执行。
summary.importance: 提出分层解耦的VLM规划+扩散动作专家范式，属于具身智能中较有代表性的“规划-控制”分离路线；对多模态/行动模型的训练组织方式有一定启发，但对纯文本LLM预训练直接贡献有限。
summary.technical_approach: 高层用VLM做任务分解与视觉指代，输出结构化计划（子任务指令+目标bbox）；低层用flow-matching Diffusion Transformer作为动作专家，并设计级联cross-attention，按顺序融合全局上下文、高分辨率目标裁剪与技能语义，使低层专注鲁棒执行。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键细节（数据规模、机器人平台、对比基线、指标与提升幅度等），无法判断是否达到SOTA或显著增益。

summary_en.core_problem: End-to-end VLA fine-tuning for manipulation often degrades the strong reasoning inherited from the base VLM; the goal is to preserve high-level semantic reasoning while achieving robust low-level action execution.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a hierarchical decoupling paradigm (VLM planning + diffusion-based action expert), representative for embodied manipulation. It offers some training-organization insights for multimodal/action models, but is only indirectly relevant to core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A VLM planner performs task decomposition and visual grounding to output structured plans (subtask instruction + target bbox). A low-level flow-matching Diffusion Transformer action expert with cascaded cross-attention sequentially fuses global context, object-centric high-res crops, and skill semantics for robust execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide essential experimental details (data scale, robot setup, baselines, metrics, gains), so SOTA status and effect size cannot be assessed.

recommendation.zh: 具身路线备查：看分层“VLM 规划 vs 扩散控制”如何隔离能力退化，能给多模态训练组织一个可复用的拆分模板。
recommendation.en: Embodied stack reference: check how they isolate VLM planning from diffusion control to avoid capability collapse—reusable template for multimodal training splits.

paper.title: LARY: A Latent Action Representation Yielding Benchmark for Generalizable Vision-to-Action Alignment
paper.abstract: While the shortage of explicit action data limits Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, human action videos offer a scalable yet unlabeled data source. A critical challenge in utilizing large-scale human video datasets lies in transforming visual signals into ontology-independent representations, known as latent actions. However, the capacity of latent action representation to derive robust control from visual observations has yet to be rigorously evaluated. We introduce the Latent Action Represe

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型缺乏显式动作数据的问题，评估从人类视频中提取的隐式动作表示的有效性。
summary.importance: 构建了一个大规模基准测试（LARY），用于评估隐式动作表示在高级语义动作和低级机器人控制上的泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 收集并整理了包含 100 万个视频（1000 小时）、151 个动作类别的大规模数据集，统一评估视觉信号到本体无关表示的转换质量。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 62 万图像对和 59.5 万运动轨迹，跨越多种具身环境，揭示了通用视觉基础模型在动作对齐上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the scarcity of explicit action data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by evaluating latent action representations extracted from human videos.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a large-scale benchmark (LARY) to evaluate the generalization of latent action representations on both semantic actions and low-level robotic control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Curates a dataset of 1M videos (1,000 hours) across 151 action categories to uniformly evaluate the transformation of visual signals into ontology-independent representations.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset includes 620K image pairs and 595K motion trajectories across diverse embodiments, revealing the performance of general visual foundation models on action alignment.

recommendation.zh: 具身 VLM 领域的优质数据基准，对 vision-to-action 对齐有参考价值，不涉足机器人控制的预训练研究员可跳过。
recommendation.en: Solid benchmark for VLA alignment; useful for embodied AI data curation, but can be skipped if not working on robotics.

paper.title: EgoTL: Egocentric Think-Aloud Chains for Long-Horizon Tasks

summary.core_problem: 面向长时域具身任务的VLM/世界模型训练中，如何获得高质量、低幻觉的长链条“可对齐的思考-行动-空间”标注数据，以减少长视野指令跟随中的跳步、幻觉与物理不一致。
summary.importance: 数据与标注范式贡献：提出面向具身/第一视角的think-aloud采集与空间校准流程，补足长时域家庭任务中CoT、动作标签与空间标注缺失/噪声问题；对多模态对齐与具身推理数据构建有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: EgoTL数据管线：采用“say-before-act”协议采集逐步目标与口头推理，并提供词级时间戳；结合度量尺度空间估计器校准物理属性；引入memory-bank walkthrough等机制增强长时序任务覆盖与空间落地，降低VLM自动标注噪声在长链条中的放大。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露数据规模（小时数/轨迹数）、标注类型覆盖、训练的基座模型、与现有egocentric/embodied数据集或自动标注方案的定量对比与提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain high-quality, low-hallucination, long-horizon aligned supervision for embodied/egocentric tasks—linking step-by-step reasoning, actions, and spatial grounding—to reduce skipping, hallucinations, and physical inconsistencies in long instruction following.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a data collection and annotation paradigm for egocentric long-horizon tasks that explicitly captures think-aloud reasoning and spatial calibration, addressing missing/noisy chain-of-thought, action labels, and spatial annotations that hinder multimodal alignment and embodied reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the EgoTL pipeline: a “say-before-act” protocol to record stepwise goals and verbal reasoning with word-level timestamps; metric-scale spatial estimation to calibrate physical attributes; and mechanisms such as memory-bank walkthroughs to broaden long-sequence coverage and reduce compounding noise from automated labeling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose dataset scale, annotation coverage, base models trained, or quantitative comparisons against existing egocentric/embodied datasets or auto-labeling baselines.

recommendation.zh: 作为具身长链数据采集范式备查：看think-aloud对齐与空间校准流程，能直接迁移到你们的标注管线，论文结果本身别过度解读。
recommendation.en: Keep for embodied long-horizon data collection: read the think-aloud alignment + spatial calibration pipeline; it’s directly portable to labeling ops, but don’t over-trust the reported gains.

paper.title: VAG: Dual-Stream Video-Action Generation for Embodied Data Synthesis

summary.core_problem: 为具身学习合成可用于策略学习的数据：在语言/视觉条件下联合生成“视频+动作轨迹”，避免仅生成世界视频却缺少配对动作的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Synthesizing embodied-learning data that pairs generated videos with aligned action trajectories under language/visual conditions, avoiding the mismatch that arises when generating only videos without corresponding actions.
summary_en.importance: Advances data synthesis for embodied/robotic foundation models by moving from video-only world modeling to joint video–action generation, directly supporting scalable policy learning with aligned multimodal supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces VAG, a flow-matching dual-stream generative framework where video and action streams are denoised/generated synchronously, with joint modeling and adaptive alignment mechanisms to reduce the inefficiency and error accumulation of two-stage pipelines (video then actions).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify training/model scale, baselines, or quantitative improvements on generation quality or downstream policy learning.
